raw.description:
Senior Web Developer – WordPress, Performance & Attribution

$2,500 to $4,000 USD per month, depending on experience. Open to going higher for an exceptional candidate. Remote. Pacific Time Zone.

Heads up: a video application is required to be considered. Resume + a short video interview through HireFlix. Both required. No video, no consideration.

👉 Start your video application here👈

Who this is for

This role is for the developer who's tired of being a ticket-taker. Tired of fighting through three layers of project managers to ship a single page. Tired of pushing for a performance fix and watching it die in a backlog. Tired of doing the best work of your career inside an agency where the client never even learns your name.

You'll work directly with the founder. When you see something on the site that's slow, broken, or underperforming, you can fix it. When you have a strong opinion about how to architect something, you'll be heard. The website is your domain. You own it, you ship it, you make it better every week.

If you love rolling up your sleeves and shipping work every day, this is for you. If you want to lead a team or build strategy from 30,000 feet, this isn't.

About us

We're a residential plumbing company based in Orange County, California. We've built a strong brand serving homeowners across Southern California, and we're investing heavily in organic growth. This role is a key part of that investment.

Your first project: site rebuild

Your first major project is leading the rebuild of doitrightplumbers.com on our existing stack (WordPress, Hello Elementor, Elementor Pro, WP Engine, Cloudflare). Not a content refresh. A ground-up rebuild focused on performance, conversion, and a scalable component system that supports rapid landing page production.

Scope includes migration planning with zero SEO loss, a reusable component library, Core Web Vitals targets met before launch, full GTM and GA4 rebuilt cleanly, and schema implementation across the new site. After launch, you transition into ongoing ownership.

What you'll own

  • Website development. Building and maintaining our WordPress site, shipping new landing pages, location pages, and service pages on demand. Expected publishing cadence after launch: 3 to 5 new pages per week using the component library.
  • Page speed and Core Web Vitals. This is the heart of the role. LCP, INP, CLS, PageSpeed scores. Continuous monitoring, image optimization, script auditing, caching strategy. Slow pages are not acceptable.
  • Cloudflare and WP Engine. Cache rules, page rules, security settings, firewall configuration, staging environments, plugin audits, security updates. You own the platform, not just the pages.
  • Schema implementation. The SEO specialist defines schema strategy. You handle JSON-LD implementation, structured data testing, deployment, and validation across LocalBusiness, Service, FAQPage, Review, and BreadcrumbList types.
  • Analytics and attribution. GTM, GA4, conversion tracking across Google Ads, Bing, Facebook, Reddit, and WhatConverts. When tracking breaks, you diagnose and fix it. Attribution is a craft, not an afterthought.
  • Technical SEO foundation. Sitemaps, robots.txt, crawl budget, canonicals, 301 redirects, indexation issues, Search Console error resolution.
  • Conversion rate optimization. Continuous A/B testing on hero sections, forms, CTAs, and page layouts.
  • Mobile-first development and accessibility. Most of our customers convert on mobile. Every page is built mobile-first. WCAG 2.1 AA compliance expected.

How you work with the team

You'll partner closely with our Senior SEO Specialist. They own the strategy (content, link building, schema specs, internal linking strategy). You own the technical surface that brings it to life. Daily Slack collaboration, weekly working session, clean handoff process.

You'll also have a weekly working session with our CMO and direct access to the founder. No agency layer. No buried management chain.

What you need to have

  • 5+ years of hands-on web development experience. You've shipped real work and you can prove it.
  • Deep WordPress and Elementor Pro fluency. You build in Elementor every day and know its limits.
  • PHP fluency. You can write custom functions, build custom post types, and modify themes when Elementor isn't enough.
  • Real Cloudflare and WP Engine experience. You've configured cache rules, firewalls, staging environments, and managed production sites end to end.
  • Real attribution and analytics chops. GTM, GA4, conversion tracking across multiple ad platforms. You can debug a broken pixel.
  • Schema implementation expertise. JSON-LD, structured data testing, the technical knowledge to deploy and validate.
  • Page speed obsession. You can walk us through specific optimizations you made and the before/after metrics that resulted.
  • Site migration experience. You've led at least one full WordPress rebuild without losing rankings, conversions, or tracked attribution.
  • Home services or local business website experience. This is a must. We want people who've shaped real local businesses, not Fortune 500 division work.
  • Strong written English and Pacific Time Zone hours. We're not interested in candidates who plan to flip their schedule for this role.

A note on how we work

This is a 100% remote role. We don't use monitoring software and we don't micromanage. We trust our team to do excellent work and communicate proactively. That trust runs both ways. Show up, take ownership, operate with high integrity.

This role is full-time. Not a side gig. Your full attention during business hours is part of what we're paying for.

Hours and compensation

  • Full-time, 100% remote
  • Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific Time
  • One-hour lunch and two 10-minute breaks
  • $2,500 to $4,000 USD per month, DOE.
  • Independent contractor through our global payroll partner

Reports to: CMO and Founder Start date: Immediate

How to apply

To be considered, submit both:

  1. Your resume through this BambooHR posting
  2. A short video interview through our HireFlix link below

The video is 4 questions, about 15 minutes from your phone or laptop. A real person watches every video.

👉 Start your video application here👈

Applications without a completed video will not be reviewed. Resume alone is not enough.

Finalists will be asked for a custom screen-share video walking through their actual workflow and 2 to 3 live WordPress sites they've built. That's the deep dive. The HireFlix video is the gate.

Salary: $2,500 to $3,500 USD per month

raw.excerpt: Are you a graduate keen on data and looking for a chance to kickstart your career?
raw.description:
Are you a graduate keen on data and looking for a chance to kickstart your career? Rockborne could be the place for you with our Data Programme!

Our mission is to grow, develop and deploy the world’s leading data professionals, make real change in the data industry through the diversity of thought and keep quality at the heart of everything we do.

The Programme

Our Academy is a 12-week free online training programme that is designed and delivered by our dedicated in-house team of data gurus and industry legends. We focus on all elements of Data from Data Analytics to Data Science and more, whilst also putting huge emphasis on communication and professional skills.
The curriculum is like no other, it is packed full of everything we know the data industry and our clients need. You’ll be taken through a carefully curated training programme that covers Excel, SQL, PowerBI, Tableau, Python, Data Governance, GenAI, Presentation skills, Stakeholder Management and more. On completing the Academy you’ll commence to the next stage in your learning and development and join us on Advance!
Advance is where you’ll take your data and AI skills to the next level through various projects and sprints. This additional 12 weeks of development is the real game changer, being designed to enhance and hone your newly found data and AI skills. This will take you from data novice to a data ninja – having every tool at your disposal to tackle data and AI challenges and bring real value. During the Advance period we will organise interviews with our clients across the data industry and aim for you to join us as a Rockborne employee and become a Data Consultant with one of our clients for the next two years, this would be your Assignment!
Assignments are across the UK but are mainly focused in London and are with a broad and diverse client group, from financial services to aviation to pharmaceutical. When you commence an assignment you’ll become a Rockborne employee and receive a salary which increases over the two years. Not only that, you’ll also continue to receive dedicated support from the team at Rockborne with regular 121s, mentoring and tailor made training plans that align to you and your assignment.
At the end of an Assignment, there will be the potential to transition to the client company, taking a permanent role and next step in your career. If you're interested in exploring other options, we can support in identifying your next role through our sister company Harnham, one of the largest Data and AI recruitment agencies globally. You’ll also become part of our Alumni network, providing the latest data insights and trends, regular events and updates and access to a wide network of colleagues and peers across the data realm.
We may not be able to provide everyone with an assignment through our clients but by completing our Academy and Advance programmes you will now have a wealth of training and experience to take to the job market. It’s completely free training, there is never anything to pay back and we will try our hardest to support you in finding your next role through either Rockborne or externally.

Skills, Knowledge and Experience

Your Skills & Experience
· Educated to a degree level with a strong interest in data - you don't need set grades or a certain degree to join us
· A natural problem solver, comfortable translating complex issues in a clear and easy to understand way
· A self-starter who is willing to go the extra mile either for your client’s benefit, or building your own knowledge agenda
· A desire to work in a stakeholder focused environment, comfortable blending the technical with a more client-facing aspect

Application

· Submit your profile via the ‘Apply now’ button
· Your CV will be reviewed by a real person
· Telephone interview - an introduction call to Rockborne, you interview us!
· Online numerical test - coming into data, numbers are important and that's all we are looking at
· Video call - asking you to undertake some research for us in data, can you showcase what you've learnt
And that's it, no psychometrics, trip hazards or bots.
We would love to hear from you and learn more about you and you personal goals and drivers.

Position Summary:

The Mental Health Reviewing Consultant is responsible for performing the psychiatric and mental health consultations and submitting the written recommendations.

Core Responsibilities:

  • Mental Health Reviewing Consultant shall review all documentation provided by the Independent Medical Examination – (IME) for adequacy, consistency, and credibility.
  • Any discrepancies or other issues shall be communicated between the IME provider and the Mental Health Reviewing Consultant .
  • The Mental Health Reviewing Consultant shall review and study all documents and provide a written recommendation to the Contracting Officer’s Representative- (COR) or Nurse Consultant via secured electronic transmission within ten (10)business days.
  • For employees in weapon-carrying positions and/or public safety positions, the psychiatric physician's evaluation shall give emphasis as to the employee's judgment and ability to safely perform the essential work duties of the employee's position.
  • The final recommendation shall address specific questions by the COR/Nurse Consultant and shall include if the employee is "Fit” or “Not Fit" to perform the essential duties of the assigned position safely and efficiently.
  • The final recommendation shall address whether: The condition in question itself is disqualifying; The condition’s recurrence cannot be ruled out; and The duties of the position are such that a recurrence would pose a significant risk of substantial harm.
Requirements
  • Must have a current, active, and unrestricted license to practice medicine in a state, territory or commonwealth of the U.S. or the District of Columbia.
  • Shall have obtained and maintained certification by the American Board of Psychiatry and Neurology.
  • Evidence of a minimum of five (5) years of experience demonstrating knowledge of forensic law enforcement hiring/screening experience and knowledge of the Office of Personnel Management's policies about Federal hiring.
  • Experience in reviewing FFDE cases for psychological and psychiatric illness of law enforcement is preferred.
  • Experience in performing the psychiatric and mental health consultations and submitting the written recommendations.

This job is CONTINGENT upon contract award, client approval, completion of a favorable background investigation, and the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust / High Risk clearance.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren't beholden to any shareholders—only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

The People team architects the talent engine that powers Mozilla's mission-driven work. As a Staff Recruiter (P4), you are a high-level individual contributor responsible for driving end-to-end recruitment for our most complex and critical technical roles. Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

Principal Threat Intelligence Hunter - Unit 42 Managed Threat Hunting

Job Description Summary

The Principal Threat Intelligence Hunter will sit within Unit 42 Managed Threat Hunting and support proactive, intelligence-led hunting across customer environments. This role combines hands-on threat hunting with cyber threat intelligence analysis, helping multinational organizations stay one step ahead of adversaries and cyber threats.

The Cyber Threat Intelligence Hunter will analyze public and private threat intelligence, Unit 42 research, adversary campaigns, malware activity, infrastructure, indicators, and TTPs, then translate that intelligence into actionable hunting hypotheses, investigation workflows, hunting queries, and customer-facing findings.

This role will work across large-scale customer telemetry to investigate suspicious activity, validate emerging threats, support scheduled hunts, and contribute to timely, professional reporting. The role will also collaborate closely with threat hunters, detection engineers, incident responders, MDR teams, and Unit 42 intelligence and security researchers to operationalize intelligence quickly and improve hunting outcomes across the service.

This is a proactive, research-driven hunting role for someone who can connect external intelligence with real-world telemetry, understand and fingerprint attacker behavior, investigate security data, and clearly communicate findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Your Impact

Help multinational organizations stay one step ahead of adversaries and cyber threats.

Serve as a key contributor within Unit 42 Managed Threat Hunting, combining hands-on threat hunting execution with cyber threat intelligence analysis.

Analyze public and private threat intelligence, Unit 42 research, adversary campaigns, malware activity, infrastructure, indicators, and TTPs.

Translate threat intelligence into actionable hunting hypotheses, investigation workflows, hunting queries, and customer-facing findings.

Execute existing threat hunting reports and hunting workflows, investigate results, and support timely customer reporting.

Investigate scheduled hunt detections and compose clear, professional reports when relevant.

Investigate hunting leads based on IOCs, threat intelligence, internal detections, customer telemetry, and emerging adversary behaviors.

Monitor the threat landscape and prepare initial context for emerging campaigns, enabling the global team to continue deeper investigation and hunting.

Collaborate with threat hunters, detection engineers, incident responders, MDR, and Unit 42 researchers to operationalize intelligence quickly and effectively.

Escalate major, unclear, or high-impact security events to the Threat Hunting leadership team when necessary.

Provide ongoing feedback on findings, hunting reports, queries, intelligence workflows, and operational processes to support continuous improvement.

Contribute to making the world a safer and better place.

Why Choose Us

Perform meaningful, intelligence-led threat hunting across a wide variety of data sources.

Gain hands-on experience translating emerging threat intelligence into real hunting outcomes across customer environments.

Work across multiple cybersecurity domains, including endpoint, network, cloud, identity, and third-party vendor telemetry.

Learn how threat intelligence is converted into hypotheses, queries, investigations, validations, and customer-facing reports.

Join a global team of experts who handle threats and adversaries at scale every day.

Collaborate closely with Unit 42 researchers, incident responders, detection engineers, MDR teams, and experienced threat hunters.

Help improve how threat intelligence is operationalized across a managed service.

Take part in the continuous improvement of hunting reports, queries, workflows, automation, AI-driven hunting capabilities, and operational processes.

We believe in automation, AI, intelligence-led hunting, and scalable security outcomes.

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • 6+ years of experience in tactical threat hunting, cyber threat intelligence (CTI), DFIR, or advanced security operations.
  • Strong background in tactical threat intelligence, specifically identifying the discrete traces, artifacts, and behavioral fingerprints left by adversaries across diverse telemetry sources (endpoint, network, cloud, and identity).
  • Experience capturing and modelling incident data to map out intrusions and understand attacker behaviours.
  • Proven ability to develop & deliver verbal & written technical findings of attacker behaviour into clear, high-impact notifications for customers.
  • Experience translating threat intelligence into high-fidelity hunting hypotheses, detection logic, and log-based queries.

What are your responsibilities:

  • Bidding Strategy & Budget Allocation: Manage and fine-tune automated bidding strategies (specifically tROAS and Maximize Conversion Value), continuously balancing spend between high-intent search, PMax, and Demand Gen channels.
  • Campaign Execution & Optimization:

About Us

At CoverGo, our mission is to empower all insurance companies to make insurance 100% digital and accessible to everyone.

  • We are a leading global no-code insurance platform for health, life, and P&C.
  • We’re the winner of the Insurtech of the Year in all of Asia and other awards globally.

  • We’re constantly working towards making CoverGo a workplace that you love coming to. We deeply believe that bringing together a diversity of thoughts, expressions, and perspectives is key to building the best culture for equally diverse communities all over the world.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer with a strong focus on Support & Observability to join our global engineering support team. This role is ideal for engineers who are passionate about solving complex technical problems, improving system reliability, and delivering exceptional customer experiences.

You’ll be part of the frontline technical team—working directly with customers, troubleshooting and resolving platform issues, and collaborating with engineering teams to improve our systems, tools, and processes. While this is a support-heavy role, solid software engineering skills and strong observability knowledge are essential.

About Support Team

Our Support Team acts as the first line of technical assistance for our customers and internal stakeholders. We not only resolve technical issues but also focus on advocating for customers, enhancing support tools, improving documentation, and collaborating closely with engineering teams to elevate the overall experience.

The team works closely with product and project engineering teams to deliver the best possible experience to our customers at scale, ensuring that solutions are not only reactive but also continuously improved for long-term impact.

What You Will Do

  • Triage and troubleshoot support issues, when required escalate to project or product engineering teams.
  • Analyze system behavior using observability tools—logs, metrics, tracing—to diagnose root causes of incidents in distributed systems.
  • Debug application code (primarily in .NET or NodeJS) and, when required, contribute fixes or code-level solutions.
  • Take ownership of technical issues by directly investigating and resolving problems at the code level, including identifying root causes and implementing fixes when necessary.
  • Work closely with our technical stack (AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Dapr, Terraform, Temporal, Mongo Atlas, PostgreSQL) and our platform languages (.NET, NodeJS, Java).
  • Configure enterprise monitoring solutions.
  • Conduct thorough post-incident reviews to identify root causes and implement preventive measures.
  • Automate support needs, develop runbooks, improve and maintain support tools.
  • Participate in infrastructure capacity planning, demand forecasting, software performance analysis and systems tuning.
  • Understand our product offerings and continuously look for ways to improve the engineering support experience and platform engineering tooling.
  • Participate in R&D / explorations / automation with AI.
  • Help define and drive adoption of KPIs such as CSAT, NPS, resolution time, and first contact resolution.
  • Participate in strategic discussions around customer lifecycle, retention, and satisfaction.

What We Need

  • At least 6 years of experience in support or full stack engineering with a strong focus on delivery, observability, and cloud technologies.
  • Strong hands-on experience in software development with modern technologies such as .NET,Node.js and React or Vue.js.
  • Proven experience leading a squad/team, coordinating team members, driving delivery, and providing technical guidance and mentorship.
  • Distributed Systems Troubleshooting: Proven track record of diagnosing and resolving complex issues in distributed systems.
  • Observability and Monitoring Tools: Experience in utilizing observability platforms for metrics, logs, and tracing to pinpoint root causes in microservice architectures.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills and ability to take ownership of customer issues through to resolution.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to build rapport with customers and collaborate effectively with internal teams.
  • Fluent in English.
  • A customer-first mindset—empathetic, responsive, and solutions-driven.
  • A humble attitude, an eagerness to help others, and a desire to pick up whatever knowledge you're missing to make both your team and our customers succeed.
  • Being adept at frequent context switching and working on multiple projects at once with expansive ownership, and ruthlessly prioritize.

You might thrive in this role if

  • You prefer short projects where you can go deep and chase a problem down vs. building long-term solutions over many months. You enjoy seeing multiple use cases, understanding the broad landscape, all while going deep on specific issues.
  • You have previous experience in the insurance or InsurTech space.
  • You are proficient with customer support platforms (e.g., Jira, Zendesk).
  • You have proven track record of leading and scaling customer service operations in a fast-paced environment.

Why You'll Love Working Here

Because the business operates on a subscription model, your work will directly influence churn reduction, repeat purchases, upgrades, winbacks, and customer lifetime value.

  • Manage and troubleshoot the Klaviyo and Recharge integration to ensure subscription and customer data flows accurately between platforms.
  • Monitor email deliverability, list health, sender performance, and engagement signals, and resolve issues before they negatively affect results.
  • Analyze lifecycle performance and translate campaign, flow, and customer data into clear reporting and actionable recommendations.

  • Troubleshoot execution issues independently using platform documentation, support resources, and AI tools before escalating routine problems.

Must-Have:

Nice to Have:

  • Experience developing lifecycle strategy and explaining the reasoning behind campaign, segmentation, testing, and automation decisions.

We value our diverse talent, strive to foster a culture of continuous learning, and aim to maintain a feeling of belonging and shared sense of purpose.

Prenosis is headquartered in Chicago Illinois and generally operates on Central Time Zone.

Position Summary

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Software/SRE Engineer who spends the majority of their time writing and reviewing production code. You will be a primary technical contributor on the team, designing systems, closing pull requests, debugging production incidents, and setting the technical bar through example. Roughly 80% of your time will be spent on individual technical contribution and architecture; the remaining 20% on the functional management responsibilities that keep a small, high-performing team running smoothly.

You will work across our Go backend services, Python APIs, TypeScript frontend, and Kubernetes infrastructure. Owning full-stack delivery in a HIPAA-regulated environment where correctness and reliability are non-negotiable.

  • Drive architectural decision records (ADRs) and hands-on prototypes to validate technical direction before committing the team.

  • Champion HIPAA compliance and security best practices at the code level - in data handling, auth, encryption, and audit logging.

  • Ensure the availability and reliability of applications and systems; proactively identify and address potential failure points before they affect patient-facing workflows.

  • Implement and manage comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting using Prometheus, Kibana, the Elastic Stack, OpenTelemetry, or equivalent tools.

  • Partner with other developers to design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab, or equivalent) that streamline development workflows and deployment safety.

  • Drive SDLC improvements: branch strategies, automated testing gates, progressive delivery, and rollback procedures.

  • Embed security and compliance checks into pipelines so HIPAA controls are verified automatically, not manually.

  • Maintain cloud infrastructure on AWS and GCP - ensuring scalability, high availability, and cost efficiency.

  • Manage infrastructure as code using Terraform/Terragrunt; maintain clean, version-controlled, peer-reviewed infrastructure changes.

  • Manage Kubernetes clusters across AWS (EKS) and GCP (GKE); tune resource limits, manage rollouts, and operate services at scale.

  • Implement and maintain deployment tooling - Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, Flux - to optimize workload management and enable GitOps workflows.

  • Debug misbehaving workloads, manage cluster upgrades, and drive operational maturity across the platform.

Required:

  • Strong coding skills in Python and similar languages for automation, tooling, and operational scripting.

  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes (EKS, GKE): debugging workloads, tuning resource limits, and managing rollouts. (Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, or Flux a plus.)

  • Production TypeScript/React frontend experience - real client-side UI work, not just services

  • Hands-on AWS and GCP experience: maintaining and debugging managed services, networking, and IAM; deploying and operating containerized workloads across both platforms in production.

  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools: Prometheus, Elastic Cloud (or equivalent).

  • Hands-on CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions, GitLab.

  • Hands-on Terraform/Terragrunt experience: maintaining and extending existing infrastructure as code.

  • Strong PostgreSQL skills: schema design, complex query optimization, indexing, partitioning, and migration management.

  • Experience building in a regulated or high-stakes environment where data privacy and auditability matter

  • Analytical problem-solver: you debug and resolve complex, cross-system issues without losing the thread from UI to database to infrastructure.

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment

Around here, we define the future. We are a company of innovators, thinkers, creators, explorers, volunteers, and dreamers. But we all share one goal: to improve the world responsibly and safely.

Position Summary

The primary focus of this position is to provide research support to the USGS team tasked with understanding wildfire risk to buildings, the wildland-urban interface, and other valued assets. This will require advanced level science support with experience in remote sensing, geographic information systems, geospatial processing, scripting, statistical analysis, and science communications.

Title: Wildland Fire Risk Scientist

Responsibilities:

Specifically, the successful candidate will:

  • Forward research in wildfire exposure and risk to buildings, the wildland-urban interface (WUI), and other valued assets to inform DOI and USWFS wildfire risk assessments and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Advance methods to predict wildfire exposure and damage to buildings at national or larger scales using simulation models and deep and machine learning
  • Lead development and publication of journal articles related to this research
  • Develop, maintain, and expand data sets that quantify building losses caused wildfires annually
  • Develop prototypes and identify data sources for non-building valued assets such as communication, energy, hydrological, or transportation infrastructure impacted by wildfires
  • Develop, update, and analyze global- and national-scale datasets mapping Wildland Urban Interface using building footprints, census bureau, land cover, and fire occurrence data

Required Education and Experience:

Candidates must meet the requirements listed below to be considered for this position; please note required items on your resume.

  • Must have a 3-year residency in the United States
  • This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a national agency check and background investigation after hire to obtain credentials for facility access and user accounts.
  • Education: PhD or advanced Degree or equivalent experience in ecology, landscape ecology, forestry, fire science, conservation science or another relevant field - especially study in how ecological systems function both naturally and after disturbance
  • Years of Experience: Must have minimum 3-5 years of recent and related work experience in fire ecology and knowledge with plant community dynamics across the landscape
  • Advanced understanding of ground, surface, and canopy fuel types/characteristics and their effects on wildland fire behavior in conjunction with environmental factors
  • Experience with image processing and GIS software (e.g., ERDAS, ArcGIS, ArcPro, QGIS)
  • Familiarity with raster and vector data processing and ability to perform spatial analysis and validation
  • Strong interpersonal communication, technical writing, editing and presentation skills and an advanced knowledge of Microsoft office tools for reporting and documentation of processes and procedures

Minimum Requirements

  • Experience with Python and R, and potentially AI-supported development environments (e.g., Kiro) to develop models, data analyses, and visualizations
  • Experience with shared code repositories
  • Ability to serve in both lead author and co-author roles to plan and complete manuscripts targeting high-impact scientific journals
  • Participate in virtual and occasional in-person team meetings as needed
  • Ability to work in a team environment to help shape, manage and execute projects applying geospatial data and systems to solve geospatial problems

Areas of Desired Experience & Skills

  • Ability to contribute to the definition, direction, and implementation of the Wildland Fuels Program at EROS
  • Ability to self-teach in areas of weakness utilizing available on-the-job training resources

Tabby creates financial freedom in the way people shop, earn and save by reshaping their relationship with money. Over 25 million users choose Tabby to stay in control of their spending and make the most out of their money.

The company’s flagship offering allows shoppers to split their payments online and in-store with no interest or fees. Over 70,000 global brands and small businesses, including Amazon, Noon, IKEA, and SHEIN use Tabby to accelerate growth and gain loyal customers by offering easy and flexible payments online and in stores.
Tabby generates over $18 billion in annual transaction volume for its partner brands and is the highest-rated, most-reviewed, largest, and fastest-growing FinTech in the GCC region.

Tabby launched in 2019 and has since raised +$1 billion in equity and debt funding from global and regional investors, and is now valued at $6,5 billion.
We’re looking for a Senior Database Administrator to join our Infrastructure team. You’ll work on high-impact projects in a high-growth environment, alongside a world-class remote engineering team spread across 20+ countries.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the reliability and performance of our production ClickHouse clusters, whether self-hosted on Kubernetes or running on managed ClickHouse services.
  • Design a standard architecture and tooling that let us grow to dozens of multi-node clusters without the operational work growing at the same pace.
  • Manage the whole cluster lifecycle as code: provisioning, configuration, scaling, upgrades, and migrations.
  • Build monitoring and alerting that catch problems before users notice them.
  • Own backups and disaster recovery, and test restores regularly.
  • Keep clusters secure by default.
  • Plan capacity and keep infrastructure costs under control.
  • Be the go-to person on ClickHouse for developers, DevOps engineers, other DBAs, and engineering leadership, from schema design and data ingestion to query performance.
  • Handle routine database requests and automate as many of them as you can.
  • Step in during rare production emergencies, including outside business hours. Afterwards, lead the root-cause analysis on the database side and contribute to the postmortem.
  • Keep documentation and runbooks up to date, and share what you know with the team.

What you’ll bring:

  • Deep, DBA-level knowledge of ClickHouse from running it in production. You should understand how it stores, merges, replicates, and queries data, and be able to explain why a cluster behaves the way it does. Strong SQL is part of this, including optimising complex analytical queries and reviewing schema design.
  • Ability to design architecture and automation that holds up across dozens of multi-node clusters. Experience running a large fleet of databases (dozens or hundreds of instances) is a strong advantage, and the engine does not have to be ClickHouse.
  • You have run and maintained stateful workloads on Kubernetes in production, well beyond the initial deployment.
  • Production use of a Kubernetes operator to run databases. Any engine counts, for example CloudNativePG, Zalando Postgres Operator, Altinity, or the official ClickHouse operator.
  • Experience with version upgrades, backup and restore, and migrating large datasets between clusters or regions with zero or minimal downtime.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across the whole stack, from queries and schema design down to Kubernetes, Linux, storage, and networking.
  • A proactive approach to database health. You have built monitoring and alerting with any modern observability stack, and you act on early warning signs before they turn into incidents.
  • Database security in practice: encryption in transit and at rest, access control, and secrets management.
  • Infrastructure as code with any mainstream tool, plus at least one programming or scripting language for automation.
  • You have hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure on any major provider, as opposed to only using a platform that another team runs.
  • Clear communication, written and spoken, with engineers and with leadership, whether the subject is architecture, performance, an incident, a risk, or a cost. You should be able to take a problem from investigation to production fix on your own.
Nice to have:
  • Hands-on work on the source code of a Kubernetes operator for databases, as a developer or contributor.
  • Practical use of AI tools for database observability or for automating routine operational tasks.
  • A background in highly regulated environments.
  • Any Kubernetes or cloud certifications.

What we offer:

  • Full-time B2B contract
  • Fully remote setup
  • Up to 20% tax allowance
  • 22 paid leave days annually
  • Stock options (ESOP) in a fast-scaling, pre-IPO company
  • Flexi benefits you can use for wellness, travel, or learning
  • Work alongside a high-performing, international engineering team in a global fintech unicorn
Relocation support is available to our hubs in Armenia, Georgia, Serbia, Portugal, Poland and Spain, including flights, temporary accommodation, and legal setup (if needed).

about us:

Spectrum.Life is a whole-of-health digital partner that guides organisations and their people to thrive, delivering clinically backed digital health, mental health and wellbeing solutions.

Our HealthTech delivers digital transformation for Insurers, Educators and Employers through Co-creation or seamlessly integrated out-of-the-box solutions, that decrease digital fragmentation and engage, empower, and transform their people’s lives.

Established in 2018 by Stuart McGoldrick and Stephen Costello, Spectrum.Life provides services internationally to over 7.2m insurance members, 3,000 corporate clients, 60 universities and 650,000 university students. Spectrum.Life currently employs over 450 people.

Our vision is to change and save as many lives as possible.

role brief:

We are looking for a proactive, reliable, and fully accredited Psychotherapist/Counsellor to help us provide access to professional services while also overseeing other individuals engaging in the service. The role of the EAP Client Care Counsellor is suited to fully accredited Psychotherapists / Counsellors. This role will require provision of in the moment support, evaluation of the client’s needs, conducting screening assessments, assessing for any immediate risk, performing crisis containment, and signposting to any helpful resources.

schedule:

After 3 weeks of fully paid training, delivered fully remote from Monday to Friday 9am to 5pm, the set schedule will be either 3 × 10-hour shifts or 4 × 10-hour shifts, with 1 weekend day worked (either Saturday or Sunday) as a fixed part of the schedule.

responsibilities:

  • Carry out screening and needs assessments with individuals accessing EAP services, focusing on strengths as well as difficulties.
  • Conduct thorough risk assessments covering suicide and self-harm, child welfare, substance use, and domestic situations — and implement appropriate safety and action plans.
  • Provide immediate telephone crisis counselling and short-term interventions to individuals in distress.
  • Identifythe presenting problem and determineappropriate serviceresponse level as per case response level standards.
  • Meet keyobjectivesaround call volume and quality.
  • Be the first point of contact to our clients via phone,SMS, livechatand WhatsApp.
  • Operate within all policies,proceduresand guidelines of the EAP service.
  • Maintain accurate, timely clinical records across our digital case management systems while managing live client contact 
  • Participate in team meetings and attend other meetings asdeemednecessary.
  • Demonstrate excellent customer service skills with strong written and verbal communication skills.

requirements:

  • A recognised qualification in Counselling or Psychotherapy
  • Minimum450post-qualified accrued counselling hours (supervisor verification may be requested) 
  • Full accreditation with a recognised professional body: BACP, IACP, PSI, BPS, UKCP, BABCP, ACP, EAPA, COSCA, CORST, NCPS, or APCP —pre-accredited, student and individual membership cannot be accepted 
  • Confident digital literacy: ability to work across multiple systems simultaneously and learn new software quickly, adapting to new platforms as they are introduced 
  • Comfortable working to call volume and quality targets alongside clinical responsibilities 
  • Strong empathy and active listening — the ability to build a therapeutic relationship quickly, over the phone 
  • Flexibility to work shifts including evenings and one fixed weekend day per week.
  • Experience working with a variety of clients reflecting a wide range of clinical presentations.
  • Experience conducting screening assessments and clinical risk assessments 
  • Strong risk assessment skills: suicide and self-harm, child welfare, substance use 
  • Good understanding of confidentiality, safeguarding, and your professional responsibilities 
  • Strong work ethic and professionalism.
  • Ability to work over the phone and through chat.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Confidentialworkingenvironment:clinicians must be able to work from a private, confidential space to ensure client conversationsremainsecure and aligned with professional counselling standards.
  • Strong and reliable internet connection for fully remote working.

desirable:

  • Experience in a previous EAP service
  • Experience delivering short-term or solution-focused models, including CBT-informed approaches
  • Experience working on crisis or support phone lines

• Job Type: Full-time, long-term contractor
  • Workplace: Remote
  • Schedule: Full-time, Monday to Friday - CT hours aligned
  • Compensation: $1,500 - $1,800/ month

About Us

HireHawk connects skilled professionals around the world with U.S. and Canadian companies looking for experienced remote talent. For this opportunity, we are recruiting for a U.S. personal injury law firm that values experienced people who can take ownership of their caseload, communicate reliably, and keep cases moving without constant oversight. HireHawk supports globally distributed professionals with clear role expectations and dedicated team coordination.

About the Role

As a Personal Injury Pre-Litigation Case Manager, you will independently manage assigned personal injury cases through the full pre-litigation lifecycle after initial intake. This is an experienced-hire position for someone who already understands what should happen next on a PI file and can take action without step-by-step direction.

You will own case progression from opening and insurance claim setup through treatment coordination, records collection, demand preparation, settlement progression, and closing. You will have meaningful autonomy over your caseload while working within an established legal team, with additional support available for areas such as lien reductions.

Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of assigned personal injury cases from post-intake opening through settlement and case closing
  • Open insurance claims, communicate with carriers, and obtain or confirm applicable policy limits
  • Coordinate medical treatment and help clients connect with appropriate providers or specialists based on their injuries and case needs
  • Monitor treatment progression and manage cases with awareness of available insurance coverage and policy limits
  • Request, gather, track, and review medical records, bills, insurance documents, and other supporting case materials
  • Proactively identify the next steps required on each file and keep cases progressing without unnecessary delays
  • Maintain consistent communication with clients, medical providers, insurance representatives, and internal team members
  • Prepare cases for demand by organizing supporting documentation and assisting with or drafting demand packages and letters
  • Support settlement progression, including matters involving policy-limit tenders, and ensure files are properly prepared for closing
  • Assist with lien reductions when needed, with additional firm support available for this function

Requirements

Must-Have:

  • Prior hands-on U.S. personal injury pre-litigation case management experience
  • Strong working knowledge of the full personal injury pre-litigation lifecycle, with 3+ years of experience preferred
  • Proven ability to independently open, work up, progress, settle, and close personal injury cases
  • Experience opening insurance claims, investigating coverage, and obtaining or confirming policy limits
  • Strong knowledge of medical treatment coordination, medical records and bills, and ongoing case progression
  • Experience preparing PI cases for demand, including organizing documentation and assisting with or drafting demand packages
  • Strong written and verbal English, with the reliability and judgment to work independently with minimal supervision

Nice to Have:

  • Experience negotiating or assisting with lien reductions
  • Familiarity with Clio or another legal case-management platform
  • Experience handling policy-limit tenders and settlement documentation

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Position Overview

Seeking a hands-on Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer to support the design, development, implementation, administration, integration, and ongoing enhancement of an internal enterprise document-processing product for PBGC.

The role combines IBM Datacap development, platform administration, integration engineering, troubleshooting, testing, deployment, and production support. The consultant will work within an Agile product engineering team to build a secure, reliable, and scalable document-processing solution.

This is not purely a Datacap administration role. The candidate must have strong hands-on Datacap development experience and be able to move from requirements and technical design through development, integration, deployment, and production support.

Key Responsibilities

1. IBM Datacap Development

  • Design, develop, configure, and enhance IBM Datacap applications.
  • Develop and maintain:
    • Datacap rulesets
    • Tasks
    • Actions
    • Document hierarchies
    • Workflows
    • Validation rules
    • Verification processes
  • Configure and optimize:
    • OCR
    • Document recognition
    • Document classification
    • Data extraction
    • Field validation
    • Image processing
    • Batch processing
  • Develop reusable Datacap components and custom actions/extensions.
  • Implement business rules for document processing, routing, validation, and exception handling.

2. Datacap Administration

  • Install, configure, administer, and maintain IBM Datacap environments.
  • Support:
    • Datacap Server
    • Rulerunner
    • Datacap Studio
    • Datacap Navigator
  • Configure and administer Rulerunner services.
  • Manage Datacap environments across Development, Test, QA, UAT, and Production.
  • Monitor application health, processing queues, logs, throughput, and performance.
  • Troubleshoot failed batches, Rulerunner failures, OCR issues, extraction errors, workflow failures, connectivity problems, and performance issues.
  • Perform patching, upgrades, configuration management, and environment migrations.

3. Product Development

  • Participate in requirements analysis, solution design, sprint planning, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
  • Translate business requirements and user stories into Datacap technical solutions.
  • Develop new product functionality and enhancements.
  • Participate in architecture and technical design discussions.
  • Estimate development effort and contribute to release planning.
  • Perform code and peer reviews.
  • Support functional, integration, regression, and UAT testing.
  • Troubleshoot defects and implement permanent fixes.
  • Support releases and post-deployment stabilization.

4. Integration Development

  • Develop and support Datacap integrations using:
    • REST APIs
    • SOAP Web Services
    • Databases
    • File-based interfaces
    • Enterprise content repositories
    • Business applications
    • Workflow platforms
  • Integrate Datacap with IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator where applicable.
  • Handle database lookups, metadata mapping, document/metadata exports, API data exchange, retries, error handling, audit logging, and exception management.

5. Custom Development

  • Develop and support custom Datacap components using:
    • C#
    • .NET
    • Java
    • JavaScript
    • SQL
    • XML
    • REST
    • SOAP
  • Strong C#/.NET experience is especially valuable for custom Datacap actions and extensions.

6. Security & Federal Environment

  • Work within secure enterprise and federal government environments.
  • Support security practices involving:
    • NIST
    • FISMA
    • Federal information security controls
    • Secure software development
    • IAM/RBAC
    • Audit logging
    • Vulnerability remediation
    • Application security
    • PII protection
    • Change/configuration management.

7. DevSecOps / Release Management

  • Support Git/source control and CI/CD.
  • Participate in automated deployment and build/release management.
  • Manage environment configuration, version control, branching, deployment automation, monitoring, and incident management.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

Must-Have

  • 5+ years of hands-on IBM Datacap experience
  • Strong IBM Datacap 9.x / 9.1.x
  • Strong Datacap Studio development
  • Strong Rulerunner administration and development
  • Experience developing:
    • Datacap rulesets
    • Workflows
    • Tasks
    • Actions
  • Strong understanding of document capture/intelligent document processing
  • Experience with:
    • OCR
    • Classification
    • Extraction
    • Validation
    • Verification
  • Enterprise Datacap administration experience
  • Strong production troubleshooting experience
  • Datacap integration with databases and enterprise systems
  • Strong SQL
  • REST and/or SOAP integration experience
  • Windows Server and IIS
  • Strong root-cause analysis and troubleshooting skills
  • Agile application/product development experience
  • Strong written and verbal communication.

Highly Preferred

  • IBM FileNet P8
  • IBM Content Navigator
  • C# / .NET
  • Custom Datacap action development
  • Java / JavaScript
  • SQL Server, Oracle, or DB2
  • Federal government IT experience
  • FISMA / NIST
  • DevSecOps
  • CI/CD
  • Enterprise application integration
  • Experience handling sensitive/PII data
  • Experience building new enterprise products, not only maintaining legacy applications.

The Industrial Sales Representative will maintain and expand sales with existing customers while developing new business opportunities within an assigned territory, serving direct, distribution, and Wear Solutions customers.

Our ideal candidate will have experience selling in the industrial/manufacturing/fabrication and welding space. Must have an understanding and knowledge of welding, wear mechanisms and maintenance / repair welding.

raw.description:
Position: Project Manager / Administrator

Salary: $1,100 - $1,600 AUD a month

Working Hours & Conditions: AU Hours and Holidays

Employment: Independent Contractor

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced and highly adaptable Construction Project Manager to coordinate projects, trades, suppliers, logistics, and day-to-day operational requirements.

Construction project management experience is the number-one priority for this hire. The successful candidate should understand how construction projects operate in practice: coordinating multiple trades, chasing deadlines, solving unexpected problems, managing dependencies, and ensuring work continues progressing.

This is deliberately a broad role rather than a narrowly defined Project Manager position. We are a growing business where processes and SOPs are still being developed, so you will regularly be asked to step outside traditional project management responsibilities and assist with research, administration, executive support, and other business priorities.

The right person will enjoy that variety and be comfortable being asked, “Can you figure this out?” even when there is not an established process to follow.

Construction Project Management – Primary Focus

  • Coordinate projects from planning through to completion
  • Manage project schedules, timelines, milestones, and outstanding actions
  • Coordinate trades, contractors, suppliers, and other project stakeholders
  • Proactively chase trades and suppliers to ensure agreed deadlines are met
  • Identify project delays, dependencies, and potential risks before they become larger problems
  • Coordinate materials, equipment, and site requirements
  • Maintain visibility across multiple moving parts and competing priorities
  • Keep management informed of project progress, delays, and required decisions
  • Maintain accurate project information, tasks, and documentation
  • Help establish stronger project management processes as the business grows

Trade & Supplier Coordination

A significant component of this role will involve direct phone communication with Australian trades, suppliers, local government and other regulators, as well as with the internal team.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Contact trades and suppliers to confirm availability, pricing, and timelines
  • Follow up overdue work, materials, and outstanding commitments
  • Accountability with stakeholders for clear answers and realistic delivery dates
  • Coordinate information between different trades and project stakeholders
  • Source alternative suppliers or contractors when existing options are unavailable
  • Maintain professional relationships while being sufficiently assertive to keep projects moving
  • Regular and ongoing communication with key team members regarding status and progress of projects and key tasks.

The successful candidate must be confident on the phone and comfortable having direct conversations when deadlines are at risk.

Research & Problem Solving

  • Independently research solutions to unusual project and operational requirements
  • Source suppliers, contractors, products, and specialist services in Australia
  • Research requirements for regional and remote Australian councils, policies and regulations
  • Find practical solutions for logistics such as crane operators, transport providers, specialist trades, materials, or staircase designs
  • Compare suppliers, pricing, specifications, and availability
  • Work through large amounts of information and identify the most practical solution
  • Use AI and online research tools to accelerate research while independently validating information
  • Present management with clear options and recommendations rather than simply forwarding raw information

Project Documentation & Systems

  • Maintain accurate project records and documentation
  • Track actions, deadlines, milestones, and outstanding requirements
  • Maintain project information within the company’s chosen project management system
  • Organise supplier quotes, contracts, drawings, and supporting documentation
  • Assist with developing project templates, checklists, and workflows
  • Support document processes by contributing to SOPs as repeatable workflows emerge
  • Create greater visibility and structure across projects without requiring established processes

General Operations & Administration

This role requires someone willing to support the wider business wherever needed, including:

  • General business administration
  • Preparing and organising documents
  • Maintaining spreadsheets and trackers
  • Following up emails and outstanding actions
  • Scheduling and meeting coordination
  • Supplier and contractor administration
  • Data entry and information management
  • Basic reporting and project updates
  • Assisting with Xero or basic financial administration where required
  • Supporting other operational priorities as they arise

Xero/bookkeeping capability is advantageous but is a low priority compared with construction project management and communication skills.

Executive & Personal Support

As part of the broad nature of the role, the successful candidate must also be comfortable assisting leadership with occasional EA and personal tasks.

This may include:

  • Research and information gathering
  • Scheduling and coordination
  • Following up external parties
  • Making bookings or arrangements
  • Preparing information and documentation
  • Completing ad hoc personal or executive tasks when required

The expectation is a flexible, team-oriented approach rather than a rigid distinction between project management and administration.

AI & Technology

The successful candidate should have a practical understanding of modern AI tools and be comfortable using them to improve productivity.

This includes:

  • Using tools such as Gemini or Claude for research, analysis, and drafting
  • Using AI to quickly work through unfamiliar project requirements
  • Reviewing and validating AI-generated information rather than accepting it at face value
  • Using technology to organise information and accelerate routine work
  • Identifying opportunities to improve workflows through AI and automation

Advanced AI expertise is not required, but basic AI competency and a willingness to use it effectively are essential.

Tools & Systems

  • Previous experience using project management software is required
  • Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets
  • Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace
  • Gemini, Claude, or similar AI platforms
  • Xero – advantageous but not essential
  • Construction documentation and cloud file management systems

Requirements

    • Proven construction project management experience – essential
    • Strong understanding of construction workflows, trades, suppliers, and project dependencies
    • Excellent spoken and written English
    • Confident and assertive telephone communication skills
    • Strong project coordination and deadline management capability
    • Excellent research and problem-solving skills
    • Ability to manage multiple competing priorities simultaneously

Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

Mozilla’s Customer Experience team helps users, organizations, and partners successfully adopt, use, and get sustained value from Mozilla products. Historically, much of Mozilla’s support work has focused on consumers. As Mozilla expands its business and organizational offerings, we are building a support operation designed for the needs of B2B customers, including dependable service delivery, clear customer commitments, global coverage, and close coordination with Product and Engineering.

As Staff Enterprise Support Operations Manager, you will be Mozilla’s first dedicated B2B support operations leader. You will not inherit a mature operation; you will build one. You will design and launch the operating model, vendor strategy, processes, tooling, training, metrics, capacity planning, and governance required to provide high-quality technical support to organizations deploying and managing Mozilla products.

Beyond building the support operation, you will serve as the operational bridge between Enterprise customers, CX, Product, and Engineering, ensuring insights from customers and support teams inform the broader Enterprise experience.

This is an individual contributor role with broad end-to-end ownership. You will be the day-to-day owner of Mozilla’s external B2B support vendor relationships and the operational processes connecting vendor agents with Mozilla teams. You will use customer demand, service performance, and cost data to determine when and how the operation should expand across geographies, languages, coverage models, and support offerings. As the business grows, you will also help define the structure and capabilities of Mozilla’s future B2B support team.

You will participate in a defined incident coverage model and periodically lead the operational response to major customer incidents. In those moments, you will ensure vendors follow established procedures, coordinate escalation and handoffs to Mozilla engineers, drive cross-functional resolution, communicate clearly with customers and internal leaders, and oversee post-incident reviews and root cause analysis.

This position requires a rare combination of support operations expertise, vendor management, program development, technical fluency, and calm leadership under pressure. Our ideal candidate is a practical builder who can move between strategy and execution, create structure where none exists, and earn the trust of customers, vendors, engineers, and senior leaders.

What you’ll do:
  • Build and launch Mozilla’s first B2B support operations capability, including its operating model, workflows, escalation paths, governance, and continuous-improvement processes.
  • Own external support vendor relationships end to end, including future vendor selection and contracting support, onboarding, workforce planning, performance management, invoicing, renewals, and investment recommendations.
  • Create and maintain vendor training, support playbooks, standard operating procedures, quality frameworks, knowledge materials, and coordination with product teams for release-readiness plans.
  • Forecast customer demand and support capacity, balancing staffing, coverage, language needs, service quality, cost, and business growth; recommend when to expand into new geographies or service models.
  • Define service objectives, metrics, KPIs, dashboards, and operating reviews for quality, speed, customer experience, productivity, and cost.
  • Hold vendors accountable for performance, identify service gaps, and lead corrective-action and continuous-improvement plans.
  • Own Mozilla’s operational enterprise escalation framework while designing and managing operational handoffs between vendor agents and Mozilla teams so complex issues reach the right Engineering, Product, Security, or business partners with sufficient context and urgency.
  • Lead the operational response to major B2B incidents, coordinating vendor execution, engineering engagement, customer and leadership communications, resolution, and post-incident review.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, Legal, Finance, Procurement, and other teams to align customer commitments with operational capacity and improve the support experience.
  • Participate in customer-facing meetings to understand operational challenges, explain support processes, gather feedback, and strengthen the customer support experience.
  • Translate support trends and customer feedback into actionable insights, partnering cross-functionally to improve customer journeys, products, documentation, processes, tooling, automation, and responsible uses of AI, while helping define the future structure of Mozilla’s B2B support organization.
What you’ll bring:
  • 5+ years of experience in B2B or enterprise technical support operations, service delivery, customer operations, vendor management, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience building a new support capability or substantially scaling or transforming an existing support operation.
  • Experience managing outsourced support vendors or BPO partners, including training, workforce planning, quality assurance, performance governance, and corrective action.
  • Experience with vendor selection, statements of work, contracts, budgets, forecasts, invoices, renewals, or related procurement and commercial processes.
  • Experience with support platforms such as Zendesk/CRMs and issue-tracking systems such as Jira, including reporting, workflow design, and operational analytics.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise support and service-management practices, including service levels, severity models, escalations, incident management, problem management, and root cause analysis.
  • Experience leading high-severity technical incidents and coordinating customers, support teams, engineers, executives, and other stakeholders under pressure.
  • Experience defining operational metrics and using dashboards, reporting, and workforce planning to improve quality, customer outcomes, efficiency, and cost.
  • Technical fluency sufficient to coordinate issues involving enterprise software, browsers, endpoint management, identity, certificates, proxies, networks, security tools, and managed customer environments; deep software engineering expertise is not required.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to explain complex situations clearly and move work forward across distributed teams.
  • Ability to operate independently across regions, cultures, and time zones, exercise sound judgment in ambiguous situations, and build support experiences worthy of long-term customer trust.
  • Experience with multilingual or multi-region support operations is desired.
  • Experience building and leading B2B or enterprise technical support operations teams is desired.
  • Familiarity with GDPR, enterprise security requirements, regulated customer environments is desired.
What you’ll get:
  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at to request accommodation.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

Job Opening Details:

Bionews, a digital news company dedicated to creating communities for patients with rare and chronic diseases and their caregivers, is looking for members of the C3 glomerulopathy community to join our freelance staff of caregiver columnists on C3 Glomerulopathy News, launching in November.

A Bionews columnist is a patient or caregiver who shares about life with a rare or chronic disease. They write personal essays in a column format to inform, inspire, empathize, and advise. Their audience includes patients, caregivers, medical teams, and researchers. Columnists also write to a general audience interested in learning how to improve society's understanding and treatment of disease/disability communities.

All columns are reviewed with a critical eye by professional editors who will work with columnists to smooth rough spots and help the columnist grow as a writer. This is a contract position.

Please note you MUST be a member of the C3 glomerulopathy community in order to apply for this position.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Fulfill 1x weekly deadlines as agreed upon on hire.
  • Communicate efficiently with your managers and editors.
  • Submit 400-800 word drafts that adhere to Bionews policies and procedures.
  • Aside from exceptions, drafts should not take more than 45 minutes to edit.
  • Fulfill revisions as requested by editors in a timely manner.
  • Complete training assigned by Bionews HR.

Experience Required

  • Prior experience with writing for an audience.
  • At least three months’ direct experience with caring for someone with C3 glomerulopathy.
  • Caregivers must be direct relatives, guardians, or spouses.

Experience Preferred

  • Experience in being professionally edited for publication.
  • Experienced in generating a blog or column.
  • Participation in support groups, internet forums, or community groups relevant to C3 glomerulopathy.

Knowledge Required

  • Fundamentals of how C3 glomerulopathy works.

Knowledge Preferred

  • The content needs or wants of the C3 glomerulopathy community.

Skills Required

  • A swift and independent learner of Internet technology.
  • A creative mind capable of regularly generating unique content that appeals to target audiences.
  • Time management.
  • Advanced creative writing.

Skills Preferred

  • Experience in using WordPress for content creation.
  • Experience with the Slack communication app.

Abilities Required

  • Internet access and use.
  • Native or fluent English writing and reading abilities.

Who is Bionews?
Bionews is a leading online health, science, publication, and research company with one purpose: to serve patients with a rare or chronic disease. We do this by connecting them with current, trusted, and relevant news and information. This content is delivered regularly and provided by actual patients as well as professional journalists, writers, editors, scientists, and experienced media executives. Our end customers are truly patients living with rare and chronic diseases. Visit www.bionews.com for more information.

Bionews Vision
To empower, inspire, and champion the patient voice as the preeminent resource that engages, informs, and connects the global rare and chronic disease community.

Bionews Purpose
We connect rare and chronic disease communities by providing a unified and distinctive space to engage, educate, and empower those affected by rare diseases to help improve patient health and quality of life.

Values: R.A.R.E.

  • RESPONSIBILITY
  • ADVOCACY
  • RELATIONSHIPS
  • EMPOWERMENT

raw.excerpt: Stell dir vor:Du rufst jemanden an.  Er hebt ab.  Nicht genervt — erleichtert.
raw.description:
Stell dir vor:

Du rufst jemanden an. Er hebt ab. Nicht genervt — erleichtert. Weil du genau in dem Moment anrufst, in dem er selbst gerade überlegt, ob es eine Lösung für sein Problem gibt.

Kein Zufall. Kein Glück. Daten.

Genau das ist timedleads.

Unsere Geschichte:

Jeder Vertriebler kennt das Gefühl: Du arbeitest dich durch hunderte Kontakte, schreibst perfekte E-Mails, trainierst deinen Pitch — und trotzdem landet die Hälfte im Papierkorb. Nicht weil du schlecht bist. Sondern weil das Timing falsch war.

Wir haben uns gefragt: Was wäre, wenn man genau weiß, wann jemand kaufbereit ist?

Die Antwort ist timedleads. Wir analysieren Trigger-Ereignisse — Firmenumzüge, Neueinstellungen, Finanzierungsrunden, Technologiewechsel — und liefern unseren Kunden monatlich strukturierte Lead-Listen genau der Unternehmen, bei denen gerade etwas passiert. Kein Rauschen. Nur Signal.

Wir stehen am Anfang. Und wir suchen jemanden, der mit uns die Kategorie definiert.

Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung von B2B-Outbound-Strategien zur Identifikation neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten unter Verwendung unserer einzigartigen Trigger-basierten Timing-Leads.
  • Aufbau und Pflege nachhaltiger Beziehungen zu Entscheidungsträgern in potenziellen Kundenunternehmen durch gezielte und zeitlich abgestimmte Kontaktaufnahme.
  • Durchführung von Verkaufsgesprächen und Verhandlungen, um den Nutzen und die Vorteile unserer Dienstleistungen überzeugend darzustellen und Geschäftsabschlüsse zu sichern.
  • Analyse von Markttrends und Kundenanforderungen, um maßgeschneiderte Lösungen anzubieten und den Verkaufsprozess kontinuierlich zu optimieren.
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem internen Team, um Feedback aus Kundengesprächen zu teilen und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Dienstleistungen voranzutreiben.

Qualifikation

Was wir suchen:

Keinen Lebensläufe-Optimierer. Keinen Konferenztisch-Nickerchen-Experten.

Wir suchen jemanden, der morgens aufwacht und Bock hat. Der Ablehnung als Feedback versteht, nicht als Niederlage. Der einen Deal abschließt und direkt den nächsten angehen will.

Du hast Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb. Du weißt, wie man eine Pipeline aufbaut. Du willst nicht verwaltet werden — du willst gestalten.

Dann bist du hier richtig.

Benefits

Was wir dir anbieten — ehrlich und direkt:

  • Vergütung ohne Deckel: 10.000 € bis 200.000 € / Jahr — je nachdem, was du draus machst
  • 100 % Remote, keine Kernzeiten, keine Bürokratie
  • Direkter Zugang zum Gründer — kein Mittelsmann, keine Politik
  • Du bist nicht Mitarbeiter Nummer 47. Du bist der erste Vertriebler. Dein Fingerabdruck bleibt.

„Ich habe timedleads gegründet, weil ich es satt hatte zuzusehen, wie brillante Vertriebler gegen eine Wand aus schlechtem Timing laufen. Der beste Pitch der Welt scheitert, wenn er zur falschen Zeit kommt. Das wollte ich ändern — und jetzt suche ich jemanden, der genauso brennt wie ich."

— Gründer

Bist du dabei?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt. Nicht irgendwann. Jetzt! - bevor jemand anderes diese Chance ergreift.
