raw.description:
This is a remote position.

About Us:

ID360 is a rapidly growing resilience and energy consulting firm committed to advancing smart building practices and energy efficiency. As part of our mission, we are seeking one or more experienced Heat Pump Water Heater (HPWH) Trainers for Municipal Facilities Staff on a contract basis position. This role will focus on training professionals on the maintenance and operations of heat pump equipment for public buildings.

Contract Opportunity:

We are seeking one or more experienced Heat Pump Water Heater to design and deliver hands-on, practical training for municipal facilities staff across the Bay Area. This is a contract-based engagement ideal for a seasoned Heat Pump Water Heater professional who is knowledgeable about heat pump technology and is comfortable training others virtually and in-person.

Facilities teams need practical, real-world knowledge to confidently operate and maintain modern heat pump systems and you’ll play a training role in building that capacity.

Role Details:
  • Location: Primarily virtual role with a limited in-person training delivery in the Bay Area
  • Compensation: Competitive hourly

Requirements

Key Responsibilities:
You will develop and facilitate training sessions focused on the operation and maintenance (O&M) of Heat Pump Water Heater (HPWH) systems installed in municipal facilities. Specific responsibilities include:
  • Designing curriculum tailored to the needs of facilities staff working in public buildings such as libraries, community centers, office buildings, and public safety facilities
  • Delivering engaging training sessions that build real operational confidence—not just theoretical knowledge
  • Covering topics such as day-to-day operations, preventative maintenance, controls integration, load management, and key differences from conventional gas-based systems
  • Adapting content to the specific equipment and systems participants work with
  • Supporting participants in troubleshooting common issues and understanding when to escalate
Qualifications:
We are looking for trainers who bring a combination of technical expertise and the ability to translate that knowledge into clear, accessible instruction. Qualified candidates will demonstrate strength in the following areas:
  • Experience with Municipal & Public Sector Facilities - Direct experience working in or with government-owned buildings is a significant asset. Ideal candidates have:
    • Performed work in municipal facilities such as office buildings, libraries, recreation centers, fire stations, or other public buildings
    • Collaborated with local government agencies, cities, counties, school districts, or special districts (e.g., water, wastewater, or transit agencies)
    • Experience specifically with Bay Area jurisdictions is highly valued, though not required
  • Training & Communication Skills- Comfortable designing instructional content and leading sessions for working professionals, including:
    • Developing training materials (slide decks, job aids, hands-on exercises) that translate complex technical content into clear, actionable guidance
    • Facilitating group training sessions in a way that engages participants and invites questions
  • Beyond equipment familiarity, strong candidates will demonstrate a solid understanding of how heat pump water heating systems differ from conventional gas or electric resistance systems, including:
    • Load shifting and demand management strategies
    • System sizing and performance considerations (e.g., climate, usage patterns)
    • Controls integration and commissioning best practices
    • Maintenance requirements and common troubleshooting scenarios
    • Energy efficiency and decarbonization benefits
We are especially interested in candidates who can draw from real-world field experience and translate that into engaging, practical training whether through workshops, demonstrations, or instructional materials for contractors, facility staff, or building professionals.
​How to Apply:
If you’re excited about the opportunity to contribute to smart building practices and have the skills and experience, we are looking for, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your resume and a cover letter
​

About this role:

The Account Executive is a field sales role responsible for client retention and growth. Account Executives build trust-based relationships with C-Level Executives and their teams. They understand the mission-critical priorities of their clients and ensure clients receive the value from the Gartner relationship that they expect, while also identifying opportunities for stronger value delivery with alternative product offerings.

Account Executives will be given a territory of Large Enterprise clients.

In our Large Enterprise segment, Account Executives work with clients who have ~+$1bil in annual revenue.

What you will do:

  • Drive value delivery with current Gartner clients, ensuring clients maximize the value they receive from their Gartner services

  • Identify, cultivate, qualify, and close client growth opportunities through cross-sell and upsell

  • Continually build a pipeline of high-quality opportunities to deliver against your sales metrics, ensuring KPI’s are met

  • Quota responsibility for your assigned territory.

  • Manage complex high-revenue sales across matrix and diverse business environments.

  • Own forecasting and account planning on a monthly/quarterly/annual basis.

What you will need:

  • 5-8+ years’ B2B sales experience, preferably within complex, intangible sales environments

  • Experience selling to and/or influencing C-Level Executives

  • Proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales targets.

  • Proven ability to own, manage, and forecast a complex sales process.

  • Willingness to conduct travel as needed.

  • Bachelor's degree preferred

What you will get:

  • Competitive salary, generous paid time off policy, charity match program, and more!

  • Uncapped commission structure

  • World-class sales training programs and skill development programs

  • Annual "Winners Circle" event attendance at exclusive destinations for top performers

  • Collaborative, team-oriented culture that embraces inclusion

  • Professional development and career growth opportunities

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Gartner believes in fair and equitable pay. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is 102,000 USD - 147,000 USD. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. In addition to base salary, employees will participate in either an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance, or a role-based, uncapped sales incentive plan. Our talent acquisition team will provide the specific opportunity on our bonus or incentive programs to eligible candidates. Job Description:

1. GENERAL POSITION INFORMATION

Position Name: Adjunct Faculty, Dissertation Chair – Sport and Performance Psychology (Online/Remote)

Classification: Part-time Adjunct

FTE: up to 18 hours per week

Work Hours: Variable due to online nature of program. Generally, 9a-3p PST M-F; may include evenings or weekends.

Department/Division: College of Graduate Studies

Supervisor: Director, Sport and Performance Psychology program

2.POSITION SUMMARY

University of Western States (UWS) is seeking adjunct faculty members within the department of Sport and Performance Psychology to serve as doctoral dissertation chairs.

Dissertation Chairs are responsible for supervising doctoral (EdD) candidates in designing and conducting a substantial individual research project required for completion of the doctoral degree in sport and performance psychology. Chairs will work closely with candidates to cultivate topic ideas, design appropriate methodology, secure approval by the Institutional Review Board (IRB), collect and analyze data, and submit the final work both to the university and to a selected professional outlet for publication. In addition, Dissertation Chairs will serve as the head of a 4-5 member Dissertation Committee, ensuring committee members’ timely review and feedback on candidate progress.

3.KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Provide an average of 3 hrs/week of support to each dissertation candidate supervised. That work will include, but is not limited to, the following activities (100%):

1. Adherence to the policies and procedures detailed in the UWS Dissertation Handbook

2. Mandatory use of the Canvas learning management system to document student work and chair feedback/guidance

3. Weekly product review and Zoom meetings with doctoral candidate

4. Attend and facilitate proposal defense and final defense via Zoom

5. Engage in regular communication with committee members

6. Participate in 1-2 individual meetings/term with Dissertation Coordinator

7. Attendance at, or review of recordings from, quarterly group meetings with dissertation faculty

4. UWS CORE VALUES AND ASSOCIATED COMPETENCIES
The following Core Values are integral to working at UWS. All employees, regardless of their position within the university, are expected uphold the Core Values and demonstrate associated competencies.

Best Practices: We maintain high standards by using and integrating evidence across multiple disciplines.

Curiosity: We are innovative, open minded, and forward thinking.

Inclusiveness: We are respectful, mindful, and welcoming of different ways of being, thinking, and doing.

Professionalism: We are responsible, respectful, and accountable.

Student-Focus: We work for the common good of students’ academic and professional success.

Whole-Person Health: We promote physical, mental and emotional wellness in all facets of the UWS experience.

5. POSITION QUALIFICATIONS

Required

Education & Training

  • Doctoral degree (e.g., PhD, EdD, PsyD) in sport and performance psychology, clinical mental health counseling, sport science, health science, or related field
  • Evidence of completed research

Memberships, Certifications & Licenses

  • Current membership and participation in appropriate state, regional, and national professional organizations appropriate to SPP

Experience

  • Evidence of publication, presentation, and continuing education in sport and performance psychology and/or clinical counseling

Related Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

  • Proficiency with data analysis software (qualitative and/or qualitative)
  • Self-sufficiency in the management of personal schedule.
  • Proficient in document/report preparation adhering to institutional editorial guidelines.
  • Intermediate-to-advanced computer skills required (MS Office Outlook, Word, Excel, SharePoint, Adobe Acrobat Professional).
  • Proficiency with video conferencing systems.
  • Working understanding and experience with Canvas (or equivalent) learning management system.

Other Qualifications

  • Professional interpersonal skills including effective verbal and written communication.
  • Effective management of faculty and students in professional degree programs.
  • Demonstrated commitment to collegiality and shared governance.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize/execute plans and resource management to achieve desired teaching outcomes.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to exercise professional judgment and assume responsibility in clinical decision-making.
  • Ability to adapt quickly to a changing environment and learn new systems and processes.
  • Willingness and ability to follow direction from director, dean, administrators as consistent with university policy.
  • Working knowledge of FERPA student privacy regulations.

Preferred

Memberships, Certifications & Licenses

  • Current Certified Mental Performance Consultant (CMPC), AASP and/or
  • Current licensure in clinical mental health

Experience

  • Listed as first author for a research study published in a peer-reviewed journal
  • Evidence of prior service as a dissertation chair or committee member
  • Evidence of guiding student researchers through the process of peer-reviewed publication
  • Evidence of an ongoing research agenda

6. APPLICATION, SCREENING AND HIRING PROCESS:

Screening of applicants will begin immediately, and the position will remain open until filled. Please submit a cover letter and curriculum vitae. You may attach your materials as Word or PDF documents.

Official transcripts from prior institutions of higher learning must be received prior to offer being extended to the finalist.

University of Western States conducts background checks for the finalist or finalists of staff and faculty positions. The type of background check will vary by position type.

University of Western States offers a generous compensation and benefits package, as well as the opportunity to work for a leader in the field of education. To learn more about our competitive benefits and additional rewards, including generous paid time-off, medical and dental insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, retirement plan with employer contribution, multiple flexible spending accounts, tuition reimbursement, click the link below.

University of Western States is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

Your Career


The Practice Architect – Capability Development (CD) will be a part of the Center of Excellence and is responsible for developing and advancing the technical and delivery capabilities of Professional Services, Customer Success, and strategic delivery partners across the Cortex & Cloud portfolio. This role ensures the field is prepared to successfully adopt new products, services, AI capabilities, automation, and delivery methodologies while continuously improving technical proficiency, consulting effectiveness, and delivery excellence.


Your Impact

  • Develop and execute the capability development strategy and enablement programs for Professional Services, Customer Success, and strategic delivery partners across the Cortex & Cloud portfolio.
  • Build scalable programs that continuously improve technical proficiency, delivery consistency, consultant readiness, and adoption of COE methodologies.
  • Drive organizational readiness for new products, AI capabilities, automation initiatives, and service offerings.
  • Establish long-term capability roadmaps aligned with business priorities and evolving customer needs.

Technical Enablement & Training


  • Deliver hands-on technical enablement sessions, including workshops, labs, and real-world deployment scenarios.
  • Conduct brown bag sessions, deep dives, and office hours to reinforce learning and address partner challenges.
  • Develop role-based enablement paths for partner consultants, architects, and delivery leads.
  • Lead technical workshops, boot camps, instructor-led training, hands-on labs, office hours, mentoring sessions, and knowledge-sharing forums.
  • Support onboarding and continuous development of consultants throughout their career progression.

Strategic Field Engagement & Coaching


  • Participate in strategic customer engagements, pilot deployments, and new service introductions where coaching and consultant development provide the greatest organizational value
  • Mentor consultants during customer engagements to strengthen technical execution, consulting skills, and customer interaction.
  • Identify opportunities to improve consultant effectiveness through real-world coaching and practical experience.
  • Support strategic partners through co-delivery engagements, ensuring adherence to COE standards and best practices.
  • Assess strageic partner capabilities and identify gaps in delivery execution, technical skills, or methodology adoption.
  • Act as a technical advisor and escalation point for partners during active deployments

Capability Assessment & Organizational Readiness


  • Define capability benchmarks and readiness criteria across the Cortex & Cloud portfolio.
  • Assess technical, delivery, and consulting competencies across the organization.
  • Identify skill gaps and develop targeted capability improvement plans.
  • Partner with leadership to support certification planning, technical growth, and career development initiatives.
  • Measure capability progression through technical assessments, certifications, delivery quality, and field performance.

Knowledge Management & Learning Assets


  • Develop and maintain reusable capability development assets, including
    • Technical workshops
    • Hands-on labs
    • Technical demonstrations
    • Recorded learning sessions
    • Best practice guides
    • Knowledge articles
    • Quick reference materials
    • Learning modules
  • Continuously evolve capability content based on customer feedback, field observations, emerging technologies, and COE priorities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration


  • Collaborate closely with Professional Services, Customer Success, Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Enablement, and strategic partners.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to field teams by providing technical guidance, mentoring, and coaching.
  • Provide ongoing field insights that influence future capability development priorities, service evolution, and product improvements.
  • Work closely with Practice Architects (TA, DA, PE) to ensure enablement reflects current standards and capabilities.
  • Provide feedback into COE on partner readiness, common challenges, and opportunities for improvement.

Ownership & Decision Rights

Owns:

  • Capability development strategy
  • Consultant capability framework
  • Partner capability framework
  • Technical mentoring programs
  • Technical workshops, boot camps, and labs
  • Capability assessments
  • Knowledge management assets
  • Technical coaching initiatives
  • Strategic partner delivery quality reinforcement (via enablement and guidance)

Influences:

  • Consultant technical maturity
  • Partner delivery readiness
  • Adoption of COE methodologies
  • Product and service adoption
  • Delivery quality through improved organizational capability
  • Technical certification strategy
  • Future capability investments
  • Partner delivery models (co-delivery, independent delivery)

Qualifications

Your Experience


  • Extensive experience delivering enterprise security solutions within Professional Services.
  • Deep expertise across Cortex technologies (XSIAM, XSOAR, Cortex XDR) and/or Cortex/Prisma Cloud.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring, coaching, and developing technical professionals.
  • Experience designing and delivering technical learning programs, workshops, labs, or capability development initiatives.
  • Strong customer facing consulting experience with the ability to coach through real-world engagements.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, presentation, and influencing skills.
  • Proven ability to work effectively across cross-functional organizations without direct authority.
  • Experience collaborating with Professional Services, Customer Success, Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and partner organizations.

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at .

raw.description:
About Endpoints News Media Company, LLC

Endpoints News, founded in 2016, is a leading news media company with a clear mission: to deliver the best news product in biopharma and be the essential daily read for industry leaders globally. Now a part of the Financial Times family, Endpoints News has 290,000+ registered readers and continues to grow its reach with breaking news, in-depth analysis, live and virtual events and award-winning journalism.

The Opportunity

Endpoints News is seeking a newsbreaking policy reporter to cover the Food and Drug Administration.

How the biopharmaceutical industry is regulated has changed dramatically. There’s global pressure to move faster on trials, and the FDA is contending with changing consumer interest in compounding pharmacies that blur the lines between pharmaceuticals and wellness. What the FDA does next will be this reporter’s job to chronicle.

The right reporter will put regulations in context, scoop news on people and policy, and illuminate the push and pull between industry and government. Strong candidates will have a vision for the beat, an understanding of Endpoints’ mission and ambition, and a collaborative, team-first attitude.

The exact role will be shaped by the candidate. We seek to hire talent first, and build coverage around it. Successful applicants will have a background covering health policy and a demonstrated interest in biopharma. A track record of clips with vivid writing, competition-beating reporting and beat-defining ideas is a must.

Endpoints is an ambitious, award-winning specialty news publication that covers the world of biopharma, healthcare, and technology, chronicling the people, money, companies and regulations that drive those industries.

This role will work closely with deputy editor Lydia Ramsey Pflanzer and the rest of the pharma reporting team. This is a work-from-anywhere role, and candidates must be confident operating independently in a digital-first environment. raw.description:
The Investment Manager Services Division (IMS) at SEI is growing rapidly and is seeking new members on our Private Equity & Hedge Fund Accounting Teams. Our primary goal is to provide exceptional customer service, accounting and administration services to our hedge and private equity fund customers. As a Fund Accounting Manager, you will be responsible for the accounting operations and resolution of accounting issues for clients.

What you will do:

  • As the main contact for clients, we will need you to demonstrate your expertise in the area of offshore and domestic fund accounting and administration for alternative funds.

  • You will manage the delegation of funds to your team, coordinate/onboard new fund set ups, serve as a liaison between clients and internals teams, and work closely with all parties to provide accurate and thorough accounting packages.

  • As the record keepers for the fund, you and your team will be involved in the coordination and support of various year-end audit engagements in accordance with GAAP accounting standards.

  • We will need you to perform due-diligence to ensure clients are in compliance with government laws and regulations.

  • You will be required to adhere to our Anti-Money Laundering policies and procedures when reviewing all fund transactions.

  • As a Fund Accounting Manager, you are responsible for ensuring your team is in compliance with our department’s rules and regulations designed to stop the practice of generating income through illegal actions.

  • You and your team will generate and reconcile all accounting reporting, such as month-end valuation reports.

  • You will review and approve month-end valuations prior to distribution to client with a goal of 100% accuracy. In addition, you will authorize wire payments from fund’s escrow accounts.

  • You will correspond with investment managers and regarding day-to-day inquiries, including questions on transactions associated with the fund(s), administration servicing planning and reporting of funds and financial statements. Client engagement and a dedication to quality service is a must for success.

  • You will connect with investment managers, transfer agents, and sales and service teams to resolve open issues and questions, getting in touch with internal technology support and vendor support when necessary to resolve any production issues or system support queries.

  • You will conduct performance appraisals, monthly one-on-ones with your supervisors and analysts and provide career pathing and training.

  • You will also ensure staffing requirements are met by assessing resource requirements, interviewing candidates and hiring employees.

  • You will provide and champion a team environment to include individual development, promotions and disciplinary action.

  • You will support the new business development and relationship teams for prospect calls, client visits and presentations.

  • You will facilitate the on-boarding of new and converted clients by gathering client requirements, submitting any custom requests and communicating key deliverables to your team members.

  • We want you to succeed and look for future solutions! Through attending and participating in various IMS and corporate professional development sessions, you will acquire the tools to identify processes across the division and organization.

  • You will have the opportunity to partner with a diverse team and grow your career.

What we need from you:

  • BA / BS in Business, Accounting, Finance, Economics, Mathematics or equivalent professional experience.

  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience in the fund services industry, alternatives experience required.

  • Minimum of 2 years’ supervisory or management experience.

  • Intermediate skills in Microsoft Excel.

What we would like from you:

  • The self-motivation, organization and drive to complete multiple client deliverables in a timely manner without sacrificing excellence or quality.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills as you will primarily support your clients through email and/or phone calls.

  • Strong customer service skills as you will be communicating daily with your clients and other service providers.

  • A drive to broaden one’s knowledge of the financial services industry by learning new concepts and systems and taking the initiative to apply it to daily work assignments.

  • Attention-to-detail to ensure that all deliverables consistently meet the highest standard of quality and accuracy.

  • Collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.

  • As the needs of our clients change, we need to be flexible to change with them.

  • Positivity and collegial approach in assisting both colleagues and clients and the ability to work in team environment.

  • Curiosity, critical thinking and attention to detail: Whether it’s to identify a solution to a problem or possibly help implement a more efficient process or procedure, your skills have a place in our business.

  • Someone who will embody our SEI Values of courage, integrity, collaboration, inclusion, connection and fun. Please see our website for more information.

The base salary pay for this role is $105,000 - $130,000 per year. This position will also be eligible to earn a discretionary bonus each year, subject to company approval.

Work location: Remote

SEI’s competitive advantage:

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including comprehensive care for your physical and mental well-being, a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, a hybrid working environment for most roles, support for working parents and flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Benefits include healthcare (medical, dental, vision, prescription, wellness, EAP, FSA), life and disability insurance (premiums paid for base coverage), 401(k) match, education assistance, commuter benefits, up to 11 paid holidays/year, 21 days PTO/year pro-rated for new hires which increases over time, paid parental leave, back-up childcare arrangements, paid volunteer days, a discounted stock purchase plan, investment options, access to thriving employee networks and more.

We are a technology and asset management company delivering on our promise of building brave futures (SM)—for our clients, our communities, and ourselves. Come build your brave future at SEI.

SEI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and so much more…

After over 50 years in business, SEI remains a leading global provider of investment processing, investment management, and investment operations solutions. Reflecting our experience within financial services and financial technology our offices encompass an open floor plan and numerous art installations designed to encourage innovation and creativity in our workforce. We recognize that our people are our most valuable asset and that a healthy, happy, and motivated workforce is key to our continued growth. At SEI, we’re (literally) invested in your success. We offer our employees paid parental leave, back-up childcare arrangements, paid volunteer days, education assistance and access to thriving employee networks.

SEI is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

AI Acceptable Use in the application and interview process:

SEI acknowledges the growing integration of artificial intelligence (AI) tools into individuals’ personal and professional lives. If you intend to incorporate the use of any AI tools at any stage of the application and/or interview process, please ensure you have reviewed and adhere to our AI use guidelines.

NOW HIRING: CAPITAL PROJECTS ESTIMATOR

OVERVIEW

Job Title: Staff Capital Cost Estimator

Location: Remote (U.S. Only). Can be located anywhere in the US. Option to relocate to Cleveland, OH.

Travel: 30% (Site visits required within the U.S.)

Schedule: M-F, Days. 40 Hrs/wk. No on-call or weekends required.

Salary Range: $119,000 - $154,000 (depending on experience)

Total Compensation Package: Medical, Dental & Vision, 401k with match, PENSION PLAN, Company Stock Options, API Bonus, Continuing Education, Gym Reimbursement, Paid Travel Expenses, and more!

Required Experience: At least 10+ years of combined engineering and cost estimating experience. Demonstrated experience with Class 4 estimations for Industrial projects. Must have a Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (any discipline) or Construction Management.

Employment: Full-Time W2, Direct Hire

ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY:

We are placing a Staff Capital Cost Estimator (Class 3 & 4) on behalf of a global leader in manufacturing. This is a company where people don't just come to work, they build careers. This role owns the estimating function for capital projects across a large-scale North American manufacturing and distribution network, covering facility expansions, warehouse improvements, and continuous improvement initiatives across the global supply chain.

This is a high-impact role. You'll be the first dedicated estimator in the organization, supporting capital expansion projects at manufacturing and distribution facilities across North America. You'll work hand-in-hand with engineering, operations, supply chain, and project management teams to translate project concepts and designs into clear financial insights.

If you're someone who gets energized by complex problems, likes having a seat at the table, and can translate technical scope into financial insight that leadership actually acts on, this is the role for you.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

  • Developing Class 3 and Class 4 capital cost estimates for manufacturing, warehouse, and facility expansion projects
  • Producing detailed quantity take-offs and cost breakdowns across multiple engineering disciplines — equipment, civil/structural, mechanical, electrical, instrumentation
  • Building, refining, and owning estimating methodologies and tools for the organization
  • Reviewing engineering drawings, specs, scope of work documents, bid packages, and vendor/contractor quotes for accuracy and completeness
  • Collaborating directly with business stakeholders, the design team, and project engineers to scope and estimate capital projects
  • Researching and validating market pricing, labor rates, and equipment costs to keep estimates current and defensible
  • Presenting estimates to internal stakeholders and leadership with clarity and confidence
  • Traveling to manufacturing and distribution sites (~30%) for project-specific site visits — typical trips are 2–3 days

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

These are non-negotiable minimum requirements. Please review carefully before applying.

Experience — The Most Important Piece

We need someone for whom estimating is their primary professional identity. While an engineering foundation is important, you must have proven experience as an estimator.

What we Need to See:

  • 10+ years of combined experience in construction, estimating, pre-construction, or capital project roles
    • Experience can be a combination (e.g., 4 years dedicated estimating + 6 years engineering) — but estimating must be a substantive part of that history
  • Proven experience with Class 3 and Class 4 estimation for Industrial and Manufacturing projects.
  • Experience estimating high-budget Industrial/Manufacturing projects valued $20million+
  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. — no sponsorship is available for this role

Education Bachelor's degree in Engineering (any discipline) or Construction Management

Required Technical Skills:

  • Hands-on experience with industry-standard estimating software — tools like ProEst, Procore, RS Means, or comparable platforms (specific tools are flexible; you must have used professional estimating software)
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Project)
  • Experience developing Scope of Work documents and reviewing approval vendors and contract bid packages
  • Experience with project management including coordination of cross-functional teams

Strongly Preferred:

  • Background from a general contractor, engineering firm, or construction management firm focused on capital/industrial projects
  • Industrial or chemical estimating experience is preferred over commercial or retail construction

Nice to have, but not required: Strong candidates without these are still encouraged to apply.

  • Membership or certification through ASPE (American Society of Professional Estimators)
  • Experience estimating projects at manufacturing or chemical/industrial processing facilities
  • Familiarity with capital project lifecycles including pre-construction, design, and construction phases

MILITARY VETERANS & MILITARY SPOUSES — YOU BELONG HERE

Blue United Sourcing is a Veteran-Owned Small Business, and we actively recruit from the military community. You are strongly encouraged to apply.

Don’t fit the criteria for this role? Join our Talent Network to be matched with future job openings that fit your experience and career goals.

Blue United Sourcing is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

About Accelerant

Accelerant is a data-driven risk exchange connecting underwriters of specialty insurance risk with risk capital providers. Accelerant was founded in 2018 by a group of longtime insurance industry executives and technology experts who shared a vision of rebuilding the way risk is exchanged – so that it works better, for everyone. The Accelerant risk exchange does business across more than 20 different countries and 250 specialty products, and we are proud that our insurers have been awarded an AM Best A- (Excellent) rating. For more information, please visit .

Overview

Accelerant is looking for an Operations Manager to join our UK and Europe Operations Team, this role will report into Operations Lead UK and Europe. You will work alongside the Sales & Distribution, Technology, Finance and Outsourced Operations teams to manage data onboarding, premium and cash management of speciality underwriters within Europe and UK, at Accelerant we call them members.

In this role you will build relationships and intimate knowledge of our members data, technology and processes and will be the point contact on all data queries, problems and solutions.

You will work alongside our members to assist them in the analysis and resolution of data quality issues that impact data ingestion, regulatory compliance, and reporting, utilising your knowledge and experience of the applicable data standards.

Your role will contribute to the overall success of the Operations function who are charged with transforming our data processes to deliver governed, timely and high-fidelity data sources.

Key Responsibilities

Member Onboarding

oManage the operational due diligence and onboarding procedures for new Members and Business expansions

oResponsible for coordination and management of the Bank accounts, systems, and regulatory reports onboarding procedures.

oResponsible for onboarding of new Tax authorities and liaison with the Tax department

oManage reconciliation between Written & Paid Bordereaux against cash received, manage, and oversee the transition to Outsourced Operations team DUA & Credit Control teams

oLiaise with members on invoicing procedures at the onboarding stage

oEnsure the Member Crib sheet have extensive notes for both Delegated Underwriting Authority and Credit Control Teams

Operations Management

oManage operational procedures and adherence to controls

oManage the bordereaux and query resolution KPIs and create an environment of continuous improvement

oProvide Operations Health reports for the monthly member meetings.

oDeliver, alongside the team, the Operational KPIs for onboarding, premium and cash operations

oOverseeing collection procedures and being a point of escalation for the Credit Controllers on difficult to collect cashes.

oEnsuring that targets for debt are met and aim to continuously improve upon such targets with improved working practices.

oInvestigating and resolving queries both internally and externally around outstanding items

oProvide management oversight to the outsourced operations to ensure the operational KPIs are met

oWork closely with senior management to develop the reporting processes, controls, and systems

oAssist in the implementation of new procedures, maintain, and improve internal controls to ensure compliance

Skills and qualifications Required:

oBachelor’s degree (or equivalent) required.

oAble to thrive in a fast-paced environment and flexibility dealing with significant operational change.

oAble to accomplish tasks with minimal supervision, maintain accuracy, and meet deadlines.

oExcellent written and oral communication skills around highly technical items

The technical skills and experience you'll need to be proficient are:

o5+ years of experience in Property, Liability and Specialty Insurance

oSolid technical knowledge of creating and processing Bordereaux

oExcellent English language, written and spoken is required, European languages advantageous

oLloyds Market Experience

oExperience of managing MGA Operations, preferred experience of the specialty market

oExcellent communication skills

oArticulate and confident in person, able to fit into a fast paced, dynamic environment with a 'can do attitude' and ability to build relationships across different levels of business

oAdvanced Microsoft Excel skills

oExcellent time management, attention to detail and follow-up skills.

oAbility to work autonomously and contribute to team objectives.

oProficiency in Microsoft Office and data management tools

Part-Time, Philadelphia, PA

raw.title: Head of Product
raw.excerpt: About ImpruvonImpruvon builds software and connected hardware that makes medication management safer for vulnerable populations in group homes, supported living, assisted living, behavioral health, and long-term care.
raw.description:
About ImpruvonImpruvon builds software and connected hardware that makes medication management safer for vulnerable populations in group homes, supported living, assisted living, behavioral health, and long-term care. In these settings, a large share of medication administration is handled by non-clinical staff working from paper, spreadsheets, and memory.

Our platform combines eMAR+ software, Smart Medboxes, emergency kits, and gamified self-medication tools into one connected system that prevents errors before they happen rather than documenting them after. We support providers, state agencies, and pharmacy partners across 20+ states, and we recently won the first statewide medication management contract of its kind in the United States.

Our results so far:
  • 48% reduction in medication errors
  • 39% increase in compliance
  • 69% improvement in audit-ready documentation

About the RoleWe are looking for a Head of Product to own product strategy and execution at Impruvon and to build the Product function from the ground up. You will lead a team of two today, a Product Lead and a Product Specialist, with plans to grow.

We are a growing startup, and this function is being built rather than maintained. You will have real ownership, very little inherited process, and a direct line to the CEO. Product has been driven by our leadership team to date, and we are committed to a deliberate, unhurried handoff of that ownership to you, including knowledge transfer, context on customers and commitments, and hands-on support while you take the reins. You will not be handed a backlog and left to guess.

We are building toward empowered product teams, where leadership sets priorities and outcomes and teams have real autonomy to discover how to achieve them. You and our engineering leadership will define how Product and Engineering work together. Our engineers are product-minded and deeply involved in how the product takes shape, and we are intentionally not prescribing a rigid handoff model.

Our product operates in a regulated, high-stakes environment. A missed dose is a patient safety event, not a support ticket, and our customers are audited by state agencies whose requirements differ state by state. Product judgment here means understanding what actually happens in a group home at 7am during a shift change, not what looks good in a spec.

Key Responsibilities

Own the roadmap
  • Own product strategy and the roadmap across our full surface area: software, connected hardware, and pharmacy and EHR integrations. Publish it so the company can see what is coming and why
  • Bring a point of view on where the platform should go over the next 12 to 24 months, and make the case for it
  • Weigh patient safety, HIPAA, and state-by-state regulatory requirements from the start rather than retrofitting them. In our environment, "ship it and iterate" is not always available
  • Treat reporting, audit trails, and business intelligence as first-class product. Audit-ready documentation is one of the main reasons customers choose us
Lead discovery
  • Spend real time with caregivers, house managers, administrators, nurses, and state agency stakeholders, and observe workflows rather than consuming feedback secondhand
  • Distinguish recurring needs from individual feature requests, and explain the difference to Sales and Customer Success
  • Design for three very different users: administrators who need oversight and audit readiness, caregivers who need speed and clarity mid-shift, and the individuals receiving care, some of whom are building medication independence for the first time
  • Design into existing routines rather than around them. Our customers cannot absorb a system that reshapes how a shift runs, and for non-clinical staff on shared devices, usability is a safety requirement rather than a preference
  • Set the bar for product definition: clear problem statements, acceptance criteria, and edge-case thinking Engineering can build from without guesswork. Define success measures before work starts, and measure what actually happened after release
Build the function
  • Establish how product gets practiced here: how problems get framed, how discovery happens, how decisions get made, and how outcomes get measured
  • Lead, coach, and develop the Product team, and hire as scope expands, including roles that do not exist yet
  • Keep Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and Operations aligned on priorities and what is changing, and support them on strategic accounts and state-level opportunities where product credibility matters
Work with AI
We expect our product leader to set the standard on AI rather than delegate it.
  • Use tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent agentic development environments to explore the codebase, work with data, and build functional prototypes rather than relying only on mockups and specs
  • Establish these practices across the Product team and coach your people into them
The goal is better-informed decisions about scope and value, not handing engineering a flashy prototype to productionize.
You do not need to be a software engineer, and you will have strong engineering partnership for that. You do need to be willing and able to build.
What This Role Is Not
This is not a purely strategic or advisory position, and it is not a roadmap-maintenance or backlog-management role. You will be the most senior product person in the company, with no layer between you and the problem. If you are looking to set direction and hand execution to a team of PMs, this is not the right fit today. If being close to customers, requirements, and shipped software is what you have been missing, it likely is.

Skills, Knowledge, & Experience

Requirements
  • 8+ years in product management, including end-to-end ownership of a roadmap covering discovery, definition, and delivery, not solely execution of a roadmap someone else set
  • Experience leading product people, including hiring and onboarding rather than only managing an inherited team
  • A track record of shipping B2B SaaS in close partnership with Engineering
  • Experience building product process where little or none existed
  • Strong discovery skills: customer interviewing, problem validation, prototyping, and experimentation, with examples of how evidence changed your approach
  • Experience with products where the buyer and the user are different people. Our contracts are signed by provider executives and state agencies, and the software is used by non-clinical caregivers mid-shift
  • Practical, frequent use of LLMs in your day-to-day work
  • Comfort working with data directly, strong written communication, and the judgment to decide with incomplete information and own the outcome
  • Willingness to travel occasionally, up to roughly 15%, for customer and facility site visits, team meetings, and industry events
Nice to Have
  • Experience in healthcare technology, IDD services, assisted living, behavioral health, long-term care, or medication management, or another regulated environment where safety and compliance shape product decisions
  • Experience with enterprise, government, or state agency customers, including procurement and reporting requirements
  • Experience shipping products that combine software and connected hardware
  • Experience with integration-dependent products (HL7, JSON, REST APIs, pharmacy management systems, EHRs)
  • Experience scaling a Product function from a small team, or shipping products and internal tools you personally prototyped using AI-assisted development
Personal Attributes
  • A builder. Your instinct when you have an idea is to make something and test it.
  • Low ego and strong point of view. You advocate hard for a position and change it when the evidence changes.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity. You do not need a detailed roadmap to know what to do next.
  • Intellectually curious. You want to understand why a workflow works the way it does, not just what feature someone asked for.
  • Energized by the mission. Many of the people affected by our product cannot advocate for themselves. Medication management failures are not abstract software problems here.

Benefits & Compensation

At Impruvon, we know our people are our greatest asset. We provide a benefits package designed to support your well-being and growth, including:
  • Base salary of $183,000 to $225,000, depending on experience
  • Equity participation
  • 100% company-paid medical coverage (base plan)
  • Dental and vision available
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Company-paid life, AD&D, STD and LTD insurance
  • Lifestyle Spending Account (wellness, personal use, and company swag)
  • Flexible PTO plus company holidays
  • Flexible, remote-friendly work environment
Why Join Us
Working at Impruvon means being part of a mission-driven, passionate, and collaborative team. Every role contributes to improving lives and reducing risks in care settings across the country. Your expertise will help ensure we can continue to innovate, grow, and deliver on our promise of safer, smarter care.

What you bring to the table:

  • You just get it. You’re sharp, dynamic, and ready to become a key player in a fast-growing firm where your ideas make an impact.

We are looking for somebody talented and dynamic. We are a growing firm and the individual that is selected for this position will become a key member of our team!

raw.excerpt: About us SwimOutlet is the largest online specialty retailer for swimming and water sports in the US, and part of Spiraledge, whose brands include EverydayYoga, Swim.
raw.description:
About us

SwimOutlet is the largest online specialty retailer for swimming and water sports in the US, and part of Spiraledge, whose brands include EverydayYoga, Swim.com, Practyce and Tend. We are a small marketing team running more than ten million dollars a year of paid media in house across about ten channels, and we move fast.

The role

You own SwimOutlet's organic social presence end to end, and you own the production of our social and paid social creative. Publishing and scheduling are part of it, and so is repurposing what we already have. We are looking for a maker: someone who shoots and edits video, produces UGC, cuts motion graphics and builds statics, and who can make content that is authentically of the swim world and content that actually sells product. Knowing the difference between those two things is most of the job.

You will have internal design and digital media support and a freelance budget to extend your capacity. The output is still yours.

You will also run our ambassador program as a measurable channel, manage community, and work weekly with the CMO on the paid content pipeline.

You will not buy media or run the ad accounts; our paid media team does that. You will be expected to read the results with us every week and change what you make because of them.

What you will own

Content production

  • Make the work. You are our primary producer of social and paid social creative across short-form video, UGC, motion graphics and statics.
  • Shoot and edit on demand and on location, including on a pool deck and at meets, around launches and campaign moments.
  • Produce a consistent pipeline of testable creative for Meta and our other paid social channels, agreeing weekly with the CMO on what to make next.
  • Direct and produce UGC through our ambassador roster and creator network.
  • Publish and schedule across our channels. This is a hands-on role and posting is part of it.
  • Repurpose what we already have into new formats and placements: cutting longer footage into shorts, reworking UGC into paid ads, adapting statics across surfaces.
  • Use our internal designers, the digital media team and external freelancers to extend your capacity. They support the output, you own it.
  • Use AI tools wherever they genuinely speed things up: ideation, scripting, editing, and image or video generation.

Channel strategy and operations

  • Own SwimOutlet's and our private label Sporti's organic social presence end to end across prioritized channels: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts.
  • Run a full audit of our branded social channels in your first 60 days and recommend what to prioritize, maintain or sunset.
  • Operate those channels to a high standard: planning, production, publishing, community management and performance tracking.
  • Manage Tolstoy shoppable video for on-site and retention relevance.

Creative testing and performance

  • Lead creative ideation and testing for paid social: hooks, angles, copy, formats.
  • Meet weekly with the CMO to review paid creative performance and agree what to produce more of.
  • Own creative-side performance analysis: CTR, CPM, thumbstop rate, hook rate, hold rate, engagement rate and outbound CTR.
  • Turn that analysis into clear calls on which angles and formats to double down on.

Community and ambassador program

  • Run the ambassador program as a measurable channel, including UGC and influencer sourcing within it.
  • Recruit, brief, track output and evaluate ROI per ambassador, and refine the roster toward the highest-value partners.
  • Manage community engagement across DMs, comments and tagged content.
  • Escalate anything sensitive on PR, CX or legal with good judgement about what needs to come to the CMO.

Product and merchandising alignment

  • Keep a clear feed of prioritization inputs from the buying and planning teams so social reflects business priorities.
  • Surface priority products, launches and promotional moments through our existing marketing meetings.

Performance reporting

  • Present weekly on organic performance: followers, reach, engagement rate and content-level standouts.
  • Identify what is working organically and apply it to paid where relevant.

Trend and platform literacy

  • Stay current on platform changes across TikTok, Reels, Threads, YouTube Shorts and whatever comes next. Be on top of trends of styles of content. Must be very open minded, creative and look at trends outside of the immediate swimming world, to identify opportunities across broader DTC industries.
  • Monitor competitors and category trends in swim and adjacent DTC.
  • Be our in-house voice on what is working on social right now.

Brand voice

  • Steward SwimOutlet's voice and tone across organic, paid social and community.
  • Maintain a lightweight voice reference so consistency holds as output scales.

What we are looking for

Required

  • A competitive swimming background. You know the sport from the inside, you have current access to a pool deck, coaches and swimmers, and our audience can tell immediately when content is made by someone who does not.
  • You make the work yourself. You shoot, edit, cut motion graphics and design statics to a standard we are happy to put paid spend behind. This is the single most important thing on this list.
  • 3 or more years owning organic social for a consumer brand or retailer as the person accountable for it. Agency, student organization and club accounts count toward craft, not toward this bar.
  • You have run a content calendar, a production schedule and cross-functional stakeholders on your own.
  • Comfortable producing on location. On a pool deck, at a meet, early, not only at a desk.
  • Fluent in whichever production tools you prefer, whether that is Premiere, After Effects, CapCut, Figma or Canva. We care about the output, not the logo on the software.
  • Community management judgement, including knowing what to escalate.
  • Comfort with performance data. You know what a hook rate is and why it matters.

Qualifications Supporting Compensation at the Top of the Range

  • Demonstrated experience creating paid social content that generated measurable business results. Candidates should be prepared to discuss relevant examples, performance metrics, and their individual contributions. Please do not provide confidential or proprietary information from a current or former employer.
  • Experience managing an ambassador, creator, or influencer program, with direct accountability for deliverables, performance, and results.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities independently, communicate effectively with executive stakeholders, and proactively identify and resolve issues with limited supervision.
  • Working fluency with AI tools for content production is a plus, not a requirement.

Compensation & Benefits

  • The base salary range for this full-time, remote U.S. position is $75,000–$105,000 per year. The final offer will be determined based on job-related factors, including relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and the scope of responsibilities. Compensation near the top of the range is generally reserved for candidates who substantially meet the criteria described under "Qualifications Supporting Compensation at the Top of the Range.”
  • Health, dental, and vision coverage.
  • 401(k) with company match.
  • Paid time off and holidays.
  • Generous employee discount on SwimOutlet products.
  • Home-office / remote-work support and covered business travel.

How to apply

Send a CV, cover letter and, more importantly, three to five examples of content you made yourself. Include at least one video you shot and edited, and at least one motion or static ad. For each, tell us what it was for and how it performed.

Applications without work samples will not be reviewed.

raw.description:
Our team is developing a payment gateway for accepting funds from users on behalf of merchants, as well as sending funds from merchants to users. The system involves storing user payment data and is subject to PCI DSS compliance. It contains multiple integrations with payment systems, providers, and other gateways and processors, including 3DS.We're looking for a Payments Data Analyst to join our Product team and transform payment and product data into actionable insights that improve merchant success, platform performance, and business decisions.

As a Payments Data Analyst, you will be a strategic partner to the Product, Merchant Solutions, Processor Integrations, and ML teams, helping drive data-informed decisions across our payment platform.
You will analyze payment performance, identify trends and optimization opportunities, evaluate the impact of product initiatives, and provide recommendations that improve approval rates, payment efficiency, and merchant experience.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Monitor, analyze, and optimize payment performance across merchants, processors, payment methods, and markets.

  • Analyze approval rates, decline patterns, payment routing performance, retry and cascading effectiveness, 3DS performance, and transaction success.

  • Perform deep-dive analyses to identify trends, anomalies, and optimization opportunities across processors, card schemes, BINs, countries, merchants, and payment methods.

  • Measure the impact of new product features, processor integrations, routing changes, payment optimization initiatives, and A/B experiments.

  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports that provide actionable insights for Product, Merchant Solutions, Executive, and other business teams.

  • Define, monitor, and improve key product and payment KPIs.

  • Investigate merchant and processor performance to identify root causes and recommend improvements.

  • Collaborate with Product Managers to support product discovery, feature prioritization, and success measurement.

  • Work closely with Solution Engineers, Integration Analysts, and the ML Specialist to improve payment performance and operational efficiency.

  • Support continuous monitoring of payment performance by identifying anomalies, emerging trends, and opportunities for optimization.

  • Present analytical findings and recommendations in a clear, business-oriented manner to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Requirements

You’ll thrive here if you have

  • 4+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Product Analyst, Payments Analyst, or in a similar analytical role.

  • Advanced SQL skills, including complex queries and window functions.

  • Experience with BI tools such as Metabase, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar.

  • Experience with Python (Pandas, Jupyter Notebook) for data analysis.

  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.

  • Experience working with large datasets.

  • Ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in FinTech, Payments, SaaS, or E-commerce.

  • Understanding of payment processing, payment orchestration, or PSP integrations.

  • Knowledge of payment routing, retries, cascading, and 3DS authentication.

  • Familiarity with payment KPIs such as approval rate, conversion rate, authorization rate, and decline analysis.

  • Understanding of fraud-related metrics, chargebacks, RDR, and risk signals.

  • Experience working with product analytics, experimentation, and feature adoption metrics.

  • Basic understanding of Machine Learning concepts.

Conditions

We know that great talent deserves great conditions, so here’s what you can expect when joining us:

  • Full remote work.

  • Competitive compensation with a service contract.

  • Transparent performance reviews twice a year, with bonus opportunities and salary adjustments.

  • An annual allowance that you can use for home office improvements, sports activities, equipment upgrades, and more—tailor it to what benefits you most.

  • Investment in your development: paid language courses, access to various learning platforms, and a mindfulness benefit, including psychological support with 50% coverage.

  • Career growth in a fast-scaling project with opportunities to influence technical decisions.

  • A culture of recognition: our peer reward program celebrates contributions from across the team.

This opportunity is also available for those who already live in Limassol, Cyprus.

  • EU-based employment contract and a 3-year Cyprus work visa.

  • Private medical insurance for you and your family, a corporate mobile plan (unlimited in Cyprus with roaming included), and interest-free support for car purchases.

  • 50% coverage of school and kindergarten fees for your children.

  • Fully covered sports benefits, and also access to in-house electric scooters and bike rentals.

  • A fully equipped office in Limassol’s city center, with everything you need for deep work and collaboration.

  • Free catering in the office and an in-house coffee bar with high-quality drinks and a health bar stocked with nutritious snacks.

Benefits are provided in accordance with the company’s policies and eligibility criteria.

Recruitment process

  • HR interview (40 min);

  • Technical interview (1 hour);

  • Final interview (1 hour);

  • Recommendations check;

  • Job Offer.

raw.description:
Role Title: Control System Engineer

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Control System Engineers to contribute their advanced technical expertise to an exciting customer project focused on real-world control solutions. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity is ideal for professionals passionate about shipping robust controllers, modeling complex plants, and applying both classical and modern control strategies in tangible environments.

Scope of Work

  1. Design and tune PID and advanced controllers (e.g., LQR, MPC, Kalman Filters) for deployment on physical systems such as robotics, drones, automotive, or industrial hardware.
  2. Develop plant models from first principles and validate them against empirical data using state-space and transfer function methodologies.
  3. Implement and verify control algorithms in Python using open source toolkits (e.g., python-control, SciPy, CasADi, do-mpc, Julia ControlSystems, OpenModelica).
  4. Document engineering decisions and control strategies with clear, high-quality written communication, and engage in effective verbal discussions as required.
  5. Analyze system performance, identify areas for improvement, and iterate on design for optimal real-world operation.
  6. Collaborate remotely with interdisciplinary contributors while maintaining autonomy and technical independence.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Control, Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics, or Aerospace Engineering.
  2. Over 5 years of hands-on controller design experience post-degree, with proven real system deployment (not simulation-only).
  3. Proficiency in building and validating physical plant models using first principles and data-driven methods.
  4. Demonstrated delivery of both classical (PID) and at least one modern control method (LQR, MPC, or Kalman) on real hardware.
  5. Fluency in Python for control code development, debugging, and validation using open source stacks.
  6. Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills, focused on clarity and precision.
  7. Additional strengths such as a Master’s or PhD, production MPC with tools like do-mpc or CasADi, Modelica/OpenModelica modeling, Julia proficiency, system identification, embedded C/C++, ROS, nonlinear/robust/adaptive control, or contributions to publications/open source are valued.

What You’ll Do:

The Director of Systems is a senior leadership role responsible for the strategic oversight, day-to-day administration, and vendor/supplier relationships of all core technology platforms used across the hotel management company's portfolio. This position ensures that critical business systems operate reliably, are continuously optimized, and are properly supported — enabling seamless operations across finance, procurement, reporting, and expense management functions. The Director leads a small, dedicated team and serves as the primary point of contact between the organization and its technology providers.

Key Responsibilities:

System Oversight & Administration

  • Provide oversight and administrative management of all enterprise-wide systems, including the business intelligence (BI) platform and its multiple reporting interfaces, accounting software, online purchasing and payment platform, and expense reporting platform.
  • Ensure system availability, data integrity, and performance across all platforms, proactively identifying and resolving issues before they impact operations.
  • Define and enforce system governance standards, user access controls, and data security protocols in alignment with company policy.
  • Oversee system implementations, upgrades, and integrations, coordinating across departments to minimize disruption.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of system configurations, workflows, and procedures.

Supplier & Vendor Relations

  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for all technology vendors and software suppliers, managing contracts, service agreements, and renewals.
  • Evaluate vendor performance against SLAs, escalating issues and negotiating resolutions as needed.
  • Lead vendor selection processes for new or replacement platforms, including needs assessment, RFP development, and stakeholder presentations.
  • Identify opportunities to consolidate, renegotiate, or optimize vendor agreements to reduce cost and improve service quality.

Business Intelligence & Reporting

  • Administer and continuously improve the company's BI platform, ensuring dashboards, reports, and interfaces meet the needs of executive, operational, and property-level stakeholders.
  • Partner with finance, operations, and leadership teams to develop new reporting capabilities and data-driven insights.
  • Manage user provisioning, training, and support for all BI platform interfaces.

Financial Systems

  • Oversee the administration of the company's accounting software, ensuring proper configuration, chart of accounts alignment, and integration with other platforms.
  • Administer the online purchasing and payment platform, managing vendor setup, approval workflows, and compliance with procurement policies.
  • Oversee the expense reporting platform, including policy configuration, reimbursement workflows, and integration with payroll and accounting systems.

Team Leadership
