raw.description:
Role Overview:
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior HPC Networking Engineer to design, deploy, manage, and troubleshoot high-performance networking environments. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in InfiniBand technologies, strong general networking knowledge, and hands-on experience with Fortinet solutions. You will play a critical role in ensuring the performance, reliability, and scalability of HPC infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, deploy, and maintain high-performance network infrastructures for HPC environments, with a strong focus on InfiniBand fabrics.

  • Troubleshoot complex network issues across InfiniBand and Ethernet environments, ensuring minimal downtime and optimal performance.

  • Manage and optimize InfiniBand components, including switches, HCAs, subnet managers, and fabric configurations.

  • Perform performance tuning, monitoring, and capacity planning for HPC networking systems.

  • Implement and maintain network security using Fortinet solutions (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer).

  • Diagnose and resolve issues related to routing, switching, latency, and throughput across hybrid network environments.

  • Collaborate with compute, storage, and platform teams to support HPC workloads and cluster operations.

  • Develop and maintain documentation for network architecture, configurations, and operational procedures.

  • Participate in on-call rotations and provide escalation support for critical incidents.

  • Lead or contribute to network upgrades, migrations, and new deployments.

Required:

  • 5+ years of experience in network engineering, with a focus on HPC or data center environments.

  • Strong hands-on experience with InfiniBand technologies (e.g., Mellanox/NVIDIA).

  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, routing protocols (BGP, OSPF), VLANs, QoS, and network design.

  • Proven experience deploying and troubleshooting Fortinet solutions (FortiGate, FortiManager, VPNs, firewall policies).

  • Experience with network performance analysis and troubleshooting tools.

  • Familiarity with Linux systems and scripting for automation (e.g., Bash, Python).

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Preferred:

  • Experience with large-scale HPC clusters or AI/ML infrastructure.

  • Knowledge of RDMA, MPI, and low-latency networking concepts.

  • Certifications such as FCSS/FCNSP (Fortinet), CCNP/CCIE, or equivalent.

  • Experience with automation and Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g., Ansible, Terraform).

Soft Skills:

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.

  • Ability to work independently and handle complex technical challenges.

  • Detail-oriented with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

What does Mirantis offer you?

  • Work with an established Silicon Valley leader in the cloud infrastructure industry;
  • Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies;
  • Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation;
  • Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued;
  • Professional development and training;
  • Attend conferences and working groups;
  • Company outings, happy hours, hackathons, and tech talks;
  • Receive a competitive compensation package with a strong benefits plan.

We are a Leader for Container Management in G2 (#2 after AWS)!

Mirantis is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production-ready developer platforms across any environment—on-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy.

As the first Unified Growth Platform, Thirdwave empowers blockchain projects with the analytics and insights to understand their customers and the actions that accelerate their growth. We deliver the key infrastructure and tools to enable projects to control their destiny. We connect people to the projects, games, and communities they love.

Thirdwave is looking for a highly skilled Data Scientist to join our team. Our ideal candidate is someone with a strong analytical mindset, capable of leading advanced data analytics projects and contributing to the overall data science strategy. You like emerging technologies like Blockchains and are passionate about shaping the industry.

What you’ll achieve

As a Data Scientist at our startup, you will be pivotal in analyzing billions of blockchain wallets and tens of billions of transactions to derive actionable insights. You will develop and refine both descriptive statistics and predictive models, leveraging your expertise to understand complex blockchain ecosystems and drive data-informed decisions. With significant autonomy, you will have the opportunity to influence our product’s direction and contribute to the company's growth.

You’ll Also:

  • Building predictive and descriptive statistical models using financial data, such as Lifetime Value (LTV)
  • Deploying and maintaining models, code, and data pipelines for customer-facing applications
  • Collaborating closely with engineers and product teams to develop models that drive data-driven decisions
  • Enhancing our product offerings and identifying new growth opportunities
  • Optimizing models for performance and cost in distributed data warehouses
  • Conducting data mining on public data to extract actionable insights
  • Managing ETL connectors to ensure seamless data flow across systems
  • Guiding the development of visualizations to present data findings in an intuitive and accessible manner

About you

  • Fast learner, self-starter, go-getter, and intellectually curious
  • Strong communicator with the ability to think about data at scale and beyond individual record levels.
  • Passionate about Blockchain and have a fundamental understanding of protocol mechanisms.
  • Comfortable interacting with various APIs, and raw blockchain queries.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proficient in building predictive and descriptive models with financial and blockchain data
  • Experience with distributed data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, or Spark) and optimizing models for performance and cost
  • Experience with DBT (Data Build Tool) for transforming data within data warehouses
  • Expertise in data mining and managing ETL processes
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL
  • Experience with data orchestration frameworks (e.g., Dagster, Luigi, or Prefect) and monitoring tools (e.g., Datadog)
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS) and databases (e.g., Postgres, Redis)
  • Ability to develop and deploy customer-facing applications and visualizations

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in the blockchain or fintech industries
  • Strong understanding of statistical and machine learning methodologies
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced startup environment and collaborate with cross-functional teams

Location

  • Flexible, Remote

What We Offer

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family
  • Additional benefits to help care for your family such as flexible parental leave and fertility & adoption assistance
  • Unlimited PTO, including two recharge weeks (two company-wide weeks off, 13 paid holidays AND a $1000 vacation stipend once a year to spend on travel, etc.
  • Awesome Perks including a $200 monthly Wellness Stipend to support not just your 'health & fitness' but your general wellbeing, a $500 home office budget to get you set up at home, and a $125 monthly phone & internet stipend
Salary: $149,500 – $179,500 / year

raw.excerpt: Why This Role MattersAs Principal, Business Operations at Greenbox Capital, you will help define how the company operates, scales, and makes decisions.
raw.description:
Why This Role Matters

As Principal, Business Operations at Greenbox Capital, you will help define how the company operates, scales, and makes decisions.

You will transform ambiguous business problems into clear workflows, operating models, business rules, implementation requirements, and measurable operating outcomes across underwriting, renewals, funding, servicing, sales, risk, product, data, and technology.

This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who can move from diagnosis through implementation. You will identify operational friction, design future-state processes, align cross-functional stakeholders, support rollout and adoption, and measure whether the change deliveredmeaningful business impact.

AI and automation may be used where appropriate, but they are not the identity of the role. The core focus is business-process transformation, adoption, and measurable improvement.

What Success Looks Like

  • Transform complex or inconsistent workflows into scalable, adopted operating processes.
  • Reduce friction, rework, delays, manual touches, and unclear ownership.
  • Improve outcomes tied to conversion, productivity, speed, capacity, customer or broker experience, risk controls, margin, or cost efficiency.
  • Lead workflow redesign from initial diagnosis through pilot, rollout, adoption, and measurement.
  • Build alignment across executives, frontline teams, and Product, Technology, Data, Engineering, and Operations.
  • Connect process changes to a clear business case, measurable outcomes, and sustained usage.
  • Create business rules, controls, handoffs, and implementation requirements that teams and systems can execute consistently.

What You’ll Do:

Diagnose and Prioritize Opportunities

  • Investigate operational friction across underwriting, renewals, funding, servicing, sales, risk, product, data, and customer or broker workflows.
  • Interview stakeholders to understand current processes, decision logic, handoffs, controls, pain points, and exceptions.
  • Identify the root causes behind delays, leakage, rework, inconsistent execution, data gaps, unclear ownership, and adoption challenges.
  • Prioritize opportunities based on business impact, ROI, customer or broker experience, risk, scalability, and implementation feasibility.

Design Future-State Workflows

  • Redesign workflows, handoffs, decision paths, escalation rules, controls, exception processes, and operating rhythms.
  • Define roles, responsibilities, decision rights, operating definitions, and governance expectations.
  • Align stakeholders on the future-state process before technology or automation is applied.
  • Determine where a process needs better design, clearer rules, stronger data, human judgment, simple automation, or AI-enabled support.

Define Business Rules and Implementation Requirements

  • Capture business rules, decision paths, workflows, handoffs, operating definitions, controls, and implementation requirements.
  • Use clear, structured formats such as process maps, decision trees, SOPs, tables, responsibility matrices, or rules documentation.
  • Translate business needs into actionable requirements for Product, Technology, Data, Engineering, AI Operations, and operational teams.
  • Define KPIs, leading indicators, adoption measures, ROI logic, and reporting requirements.
  • Improve clarity and traceability across system fields, workflow statuses, routing logic, manual overrides, exception paths, and controls.

Lead Implementation and Adoption

  • Drive cross-functional execution from diagnosis through design, pilot, rollout, adoption, and measurement.
  • Create implementation plans, stakeholder communications, SOP updates, training materials, and enablement resources.
  • Influence teams and drive behavior change without direct authority.
  • Identify risks, manage tradeoffs, escalate blockers, and maintain accountability across stakeholders.
  • Track adoption and operating performance after launch and refine the process based on results.

Apply AI and Automation Judgment

  • Evaluate where AI, automation, workflow tooling, deterministic rules, or human-in-the-loop processes can improve outcomes.
  • Determine whether a workflow is ready for automation or first requires cleaner data, better design, clearer rules, or stronger controls.
  • Partner with Product, Technology, Data, Engineering, and AI Operations to test and validate automated or AI-enabled workflows where appropriate.
  • Ensure solutions reflect business intent and support the desired operating, customer, broker, risk, and financial outcomes.

You’re a Strong Fit If:

  • You have personally transformed a messy business workflow into an adopted, measurable operating improvement.
  • You can connect workflow changes to business outcomes.
  • You are comfortable investigating ambiguous problems and creating structure where none exists.
  • You know how to challenge assumptions, ask the right questions, and uncover the real source of an operational problem.
  • You can drive cross-functional adoption without direct authority.
  • You can simplify complexity for both executives and frontline users.
  • You are comfortable working directly with senior leaders and presenting clear, structured recommendations.
  • You understand that documentation is necessary, but implementation and sustained usage are the real measures of success.
  • You demonstrate natural curiosity, adaptability, sound judgment, and a bias for action.

What You’ve Done Before:

  • Five or more years of experience in business operations, operational strategy, business-process transformation, systems design, process improvement, product operations, management consulting, or a related field.
  • Direct ownership of business-process transformation from diagnosis through implementation, adoption, and measurable outcomes.
  • Experience improving workflows in areas such as revenue, sales, renewals, customer or broker funnels, underwriting, funding, servicing, risk, or internal operations.
  • Evidence of improving outcomes such as conversion, cycle time, capacity, productivity, adoption, customer or broker experience, risk controls, or operating efficiency.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives in a startup, scale-up, or transformation environment.
  • Experience working with executive stakeholders and influencing decisions across teams.
  • Experience translating business needs into operational, product, data, or technology requirements.
  • A bachelor’s degree is required.
  • An MBA is preferred but not required.
  • Management consulting or strategy and operations experience is helpful, but demonstrated in-house ownership of transformation work is equally relevant.

Helpful Tools and Expertise:

You do not need to be an engineer or technical implementation specialist. Helpful experience may include:

  • Workflow and process mapping
  • Operating-model design
  • CRM and lifecycle workflows
  • Routing logic and exception management
  • Requirements gathering
  • Root-cause analysis
  • KPI and ROI definition
  • Implementation and adoption planning
  • Product, technology, data, or engineering partnership
  • Automation tools or AI-enabled workflows
  • Structured formats such as decision trees, rules tables, YAML, or JSON

These tools support the work; they are not the role itself.

Greenbox Capital is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

raw.description:
As a Healthguide, you will be supported by clinical teams in your strengthening of the connection between the patient and their primary care physician/medical practice staff, as well as improving the patient’s health and well-being. The Healthguide engages patients and helps them navigate their care, solve their healthcare issues, and improves communication with their medical practice.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

  • Working primarily remotely, Healthguides will be working with the patient’s medical practice staff and Guidehealth’s Case Management team, to manage a targeted population of patients.
  • Functioning independently and being a highly collaborative team member as an extension of medical practice.
  • Assisting the patient in achieving better health outcomes by addressing their questions and concerns, connecting them with the medical practice, partnering in implementing high-impact care plans and closing care gaps, escalating medical issues, and navigating them to the right resources including assisting with referrals to specialty care and community-based organizations (CBOs).
  • Accurately documenting patients’ medical history and medical issues in the electronic health record (EHR).
  • Understanding the referral and prior authorization process.
  • Continuously building a trusting, professional, working relationship with assigned medical practices and within the Guidehealth organization.
  • Implementing and meeting assigned Key Performance Indicators to produce a positive patient health outcome, while decreasing medical spend.
  • Utilize effective communication modalities (calls, texts, portals, emails) to engage and schedule high-risk patients.
  • Appropriately escalating medical issues to the Health Guide Registered Nurse, Primary Care Physician Medical practice or Guidehealth leadership.
  • Following all security policies and procedures in order to protect all PHI (Protected Health Information) under Guidehealth’s custodianship as well as Guidehealth Intellectual Properties.
  • Position may require compensated travel as needed (10-15%) to clinical sites in the Atlanta, GA area for patient and provider engagement and conducting retinal eye exams with paid training provided.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO HAVE

  • Certified or Registered Medical Assistant OR Certified EMT required with 2 or more years of experience.
  • A love for patient coordination to serve people with complex medical and social needs.
  • Willingness to become proficient in motivational interviewing, critical listening skills and behavioral change management that lead to better patient engagement.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on empathy, patience, professionalism, and respect in all patient, team, and client interactions.
  • Exceptional conversation skills and the ability to precisely document patient interviews leveraging software and in real time.
  • Experience and understanding of medical terminology and the function of a primary care physician practice.
  • Knowledge of the social determinants of health.
  • Demonstrated competency and ability to independently navigate technology using multiple platforms, computer screens, and other technical components (i.e., Electronic Medical Records, care management analytics databases, phone dialing system, Microsoft Office).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office: Outlook, Word, Excel
  • Familiarity with a wide variety of electronic health records, such as: eClinicalWorks, EPIC, Athena, Cerner. Ability to balance competing priorities while remaining detail oriented and focused.
  • Exceptional written, visual and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to track the progress of multiple tasks while ensuring that tasks are completed.
  • Ability to work independently as part of a patient’s overall care team under supervision of licensed clinical professionals.
  • Demonstrated ability to work successfully in a remote work environment.
  • Reliable transportation and a valid state driver’s license for occasional travel to provider sites.
  • Adherence to patient confidentiality through use of a provided headset during all conversations in a private home office without distraction.
  • Performance of other duties as assigned.
  • Compliance with all Guidehealth policies and procedures.

The base pay range for this role is between $21-$24 per hour paid bi-weekly

ALIVE with Purpose: How We Thrive at Guidehealth

At Guidehealth, our values come to life in everything we do.

  • We are Driven by Accountability — grounded in transparency, reliability, and integrity as we navigate challenges and opportunities alike.
  • Always Growing, Always Learning — staying curious and continuously improving inspires us to shape a better future for healthcare.
  • With Collaborative Innovation, we solve problems creatively, making every experience better for our employees and the patients we serve.
  • At Guidehealth, Every Voice Matters — we believe our collective strength is rooted in the unique perspectives of each team member.
  • And through Empathy in Action, we build stronger connections with those who count on us.
  • This is what it means to be ALIVE with purpose. This is how we thrive — together — at Guidehealth.

BENEFITS:

While you are hard at work advancing value-based healthcare, we are here to ensure YOU have the care you and your family need and the opportunities for growth and development. Our commitments to you include:

  • Work from Home: Guidehealth is a fully remote company, providing you the flexibility to spend less time commuting and more time focusing on your professional goals and personal needs.
  • Keep Health a Priority: We offer comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans to keep you covered.
  • Plan for the Future: Our 401(k) plan includes a 3% employer match to your 6% contribution.
  • Have Peace of Mind: We provide Life and Disability insurance for those "just in case" moments. Additionally, we offer voluntary Life options to keep you and your loved ones protected.
  • Feel Supported When You Need It Most: Our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) is here to help you through tough times.
  • Take Time for Yourself: We offer paid time off plans helping you achieve work-life balance and meet your personal goals.
  • Support Your New Family: Welcoming a new family member takes time and commitment. Guidehealth offers paid parental leave to give you the time you need.
  • Learn and Grow: Your professional growth is important to us. Guidehealth offers various resources dedicated to your learning and development to advance your career with us.

All full-time employees of Guidehealth who work 30 hours per week or more are eligible for our comprehensive benefits package. Temporary employees and contractors are not eligible for benefits.

COMPENSATION:

The listed compensation range listed is paid bi-weekly per our standard payroll practices. Final base pay decisions are dependent upon a variety of factors which may include, but are not limited to: skill set, years of relevant experience, education, location, and licensure/certifications.

OUR COMMITMENT TO EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYMENT

Diversity, inclusion, and belonging are at the core of Guidehealth’s values. We are an equal opportunity employer. We enthusiastically accept our responsibility to make employment decisions without regard to race, religious creed, color, age, sex, sexual orientation and identity, national origin, citizenship, religion, marital status, familial status, physical, sensory, or medical disability, Family and Medical Leave, military or veteran status, pregnancy, childbirth or other related medical conditions, or any other classification protected by federal, state, and local laws and ordinances. Our management is fully dedicated to ensuring the fulfillment of this policy with respect to hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, termination, recruitment advertising, pay, and other forms of compensation, training, and general treatment during employment. 

OUR COMITTMENT TO PROTECTION OF PATIENT AND COMPANY DATA

This position is responsible for following all Security policies and procedures in order to protect all PHI and PII under Guidehealth’s custodianship as well as Guidehealth Intellectual Properties. For any security-specific roles, the responsibilities would be further defined by the hiring manager.

As a remote-first organization handling sensitive healthcare data, Guidehealth verifies candidate identity at multiple stages of the hiring and onboarding to safeguard patient privacy, data security, and compliance requirements.

REMOTE WORK TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

Guidehealth is a fully remote company. We provide new employees with the necessary equipment to function in their role at no charge to the employee. Employees provide their own internet connection, capable of conducting video calls on camera and connecting to various internal and external systems. The required internet speed is a minimum of 100 mbps download, 10 mbps upload. Please run a speed test here to confirm your internet connection meets these requirements.

SECONDARY EMPLOYMENT

At Guidehealth, we value transparency and collaboration as part of our commitment to excellence. As your primary employer, we kindly ask all team members to disclose any secondary employment, regardless of whether it may present a potential conflict of interest.

To ensure smooth teamwork and availability, employees must be accessible during our stated working hours. We foster connection and engagement by asking team members to join virtual meetings with their cameras on.

WHO IS GUIDEHEALTH?

Guidehealth is a data-powered, performance-driven healthcare company dedicated to operational excellence. Our goal is to make great healthcare affordable, improve the health of patients, and restore the fulfillment of practicing medicine for providers. Driven by empathy and powered by AI and predictive analytics, Guidehealth leverages remotely-embedded Healthguides™ and a centralized Managed Service Organization to build stronger connections with patients and providers. Physician-led, Guidehealth empowers our partners to deliver high-quality healthcare focused on outcomes and value inside and outside the exam room for all patients.

Accounting Manager

Are you looking for a highly visible, fast-paced environment where your work product directly impacts high-growth startups?

We operate in a highly collaborative, transparent environment where drafts and communications are out in the open - pushing us all to excellence.

If you are proactive, detail-oriented, comfortable in the spotlight, and energized by wearing multiple hats in a client-facing role, you will excel here.

As our Accounting Manager, you’ll work primarily with our Controllers and offshore team of accountants, assisting B Consulting clients with various accounting and business management activities. The Accounting Manager will play a crucial role in leading client engagements and ensuring the accuracy and integrity of financial transactions, preparing financial statements, and providing accurate data to support strategic decision-making. In this role, you'll need to manage and lead multiple client projects, directly manage our offshore team, and communicate fluidly with clients to support their requests while also supporting our controllers.

What you'll do:

Perform a full cycle accounting close:

  • Produce timely and accurate monthly financial statements
  • Review and guide the offshore team's work

· Lead client calls

· Manage client budgets

  • Reconciliations, accrual and deferred journal entries
  • Update financial models and cash forecasts with actuals

Manage accounting and business activities:

  • Accounts Receivable (invoicing, collections)
  • Accounts Payable (processing bills, set up vendors)
  • Payroll and benefit clearing accounts reconciliations (401(k), medical, etc)

· Insurance audits and renewals

· Inventory (landed costs)

  • Sales tax management and compliance

Implement and use various software solutions:

  • Accounting ERPs (QuickBooks Online (QBO), Xero, Puzzle)
  • Expense management (Expensify, Tallie, Concur, Ramp, Rho, Brex)
  • Billing (), Ramp, Settle, Mercury Bill Pay
  • HRIS/Payroll (Gusto, JustWorks, ADP, Warp, Sequoia, Deel, RemotePeople, RemoFirst)
  • Sales platforms (Shopify, Amazon FBA, Walmart Seller Central)
  • Sales tax platform (Avalara, Numeral)
  • Equity management (Pulley, Carta, AngelList)
  • Merchant service platforms (Stripe, PayPal)

Demonstrate a strong accounting background and knowledge of US GAAP:

· Financial Statements Presentation

. Prepaid/Accrued Expenses

· Revenue Recognition

· Deferred Revenue

· Fixed Assets

. Lease Accounting

  • Inventory, Manufacturing, Cost Accounting
  • Equity accounting (preferred/nice-to-have)

Assist with tax process and maintain compliance with government agencies:

  • Work with external partners to prepare annual federal and state income tax returns (C Corp, LLC, S Corp)
  • Annual State filings and Franchise Taxes
  • Local Business Registrations & Compliance

· Sales and Use Tax

· R&D Tax Credits

· W9/1099

What you'll bring:

· Bachelor’s Degree required

  • Concentration in Accounting or Finance preferred

· 7+ years of applicable experience

  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP, accounting theory, principles, and practices
  • Big 4 or national public accounting experience a plus
  • Strong Google Sheets skills (pivot tables, sum-if formulas, etc.)

· Strong communication skills

· Strong time management skills

  • Aptitude to learn quickly on the fly (new systems, tools, and processes)

B Consulting is a premier outsourced finance and accounting firm focused on supporting funded, high-growth startups to mid-stage businesses in the tech, consumer products, retail, manufacturing, and services sectors. We provide founders with financial roadmaps to make smart financial decisions. Using best-in-class software and processes, we deliver peace of mind.

raw.excerpt: L'Analyste d'affaires principal est un(e) expert en analyse d'affaires, en conception fonctionnelle et en solutions Web.
raw.description:
L'Analyste d'affaires principal est un(e) expert en analyse d'affaires, en conception fonctionnelle et en solutions Web. Il contribue à l'évolution et à la modernisation des solutions de gestion des ressources humaines (GRH) et de la paie de LGI en transformant les besoins d'affaires en solutions numériques créant de la valeur pour les clients et les utilisateurs.

En étroite collaboration avec les gestionnaires de produit, les designers UI/UX, les développeurs, les experts métiers et les clients, le rôle participe à toutes les étapes du cycle de développement Agile, de la découverte des besoins jusqu'à la livraison des fonctionnalités. Il/elle contribue activement à la modernisation des composantes Web des solutions RH et Paie en concevant des solutions fonctionnelles cohérentes, performantes et centrées sur les utilisateurs.

À titre d'expert, le rôle agit comme partenaire stratégique auprès des équipes Produits. Il/elle facilite les ateliers de découverte, transforme les besoins d'affaires en solutions fonctionnelles, définit les comportements attendus des applications et s'assure que les fonctionnalités livrées répondent aux objectifs d'affaires et aux besoins des utilisateurs.

L'Analyste d'affaires principal met à profit les outils d'intelligence artificielle afin d'améliorer l'efficacité de ses activités d'analyse, de prototypage, de conception fonctionnelle, de rédaction des récits utilisateurs et de documentation.

Le rôle contribue à l'évolution des pratiques d'analyse d'affaires en intégrant les outils d'intelligence artificielle comme levier d'efficacité, en proposant des améliorations aux méthodes de travail et en favorisant l'adoption des meilleures pratiques et des nouvelles technologies.

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITÉS

Analyse d’affaires et conception fonctionnelle (environ 65 % du temps)

  • Collaborer avec les gestionnaires de produit, les designers UI/UX, les experts métiers et les parties prenantes afin de comprendre, analyser et préciser les besoins d'affaires.
  • Participer aux activités de découverte produit (Product Discovery), de validation des hypothèses et d'exploration des besoins utilisateurs.
  • Contribuer à la modernisation des solutions Web de la suite RH et Paie en participant à leur conception fonctionnelle et à leur évolution.
  • Définir les parcours utilisateurs, les comportements fonctionnels, les règles d'affaires, les validations, les exceptions et les interactions entre les différentes composantes des solutions.
  • Collaborer avec les designers UI/UX à la conception, au raffinement et à la validation des maquettes et des prototypes afin d'assurer leur alignement avec les besoins d'affaires et l'expérience utilisateur souhaitée.
  • Transformer les besoins d'affaires et les maquettes en récits utilisateurs, critères d'acceptation et documentation fonctionnelle clairs, complets et prêts pour le développement.
  • Découper les fonctionnalités en incréments livrables et contribuer à leur priorisation en tenant compte de la valeur d'affaires, de l'expérience utilisateur, des risques et de la complexité de réalisation.
  • Participer à la modernisation fonctionnelle des solutions en évaluant les impacts fonctionnels, opérationnels et techniques des changements proposés.
  • Utiliser les outils d'intelligence artificielle de manière responsable afin d'accélérer les activités d'analyse, de recherche, de prototypage, de documentation et de rédaction des récits utilisateurs, tout en exerçant un jugement critique sur les résultats obtenus et en assurant la qualité des livrables.

Communication et collaboration (environ 25 % du temps)

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les gestionnaires de produit afin d'assurer l'évolution cohérente du carnet de produit.
  • Participer aux activités de planification, de raffinement, de revue et de rétrospective en mode Agile.
  • Animer des ateliers de découverte, de validation et de conception avec les clients et les parties prenantes.
  • Présenter les solutions fonctionnelles proposées aux parties prenantes et obtenir leur adhésion.
  • Vulgariser les besoins d'affaires et les solutions proposées auprès des équipes multidisciplinaires.
  • Accompagner les équipes de développement en répondant aux questions fonctionnelles et en validant les livrables avant leur acceptation.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes d'assurance qualité dans la définition des scénarios de tests.
  • Maintenir une documentation fonctionnelle claire, à jour et adaptée aux besoins des équipes tout au long du cycle de développement.
  • Soutenir les équipes responsables du déploiement et du service à la clientèle lors de l'implantation de nouvelles fonctionnalités.

Leadership et amélioration continue (environ 10 % du temps)

  • Agir comme référence en analyse d'affaires auprès des équipes Produits.
  • Agir comme mentor auprès des analystes d'affaires et contribuer au développement de leurs compétences.
  • Contribuer à l'évolution des méthodes, des outils, des gabarits et des pratiques d'analyse d'affaires.
  • Favoriser l'adoption responsable de l'intelligence artificielle et contribuer à l'évolution des meilleures pratiques afin d'améliorer la qualité, la rapidité et la cohérence des activités d'analyse d'affaires.
  • Effectuer une veille des tendances en matière d'analyse d'affaires, de conception de produits numériques, d'expérience utilisateur et d'intelligence artificielle afin de recommander des améliorations aux pratiques de l'équipe.
  • Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des processus de livraison des produits.

PROFIL DES COMPÉTENCES ET QUALIFICATIONS REQUISES

Formation, expérience et certification

  • Baccalauréat en informatique, informatique de gestion, administration ou toute autre discipline pertinente.
  • Minimum de huit (8) années d'expérience pertinente en analyse d'affaires ou en analyse fonctionnelle dans un contexte de développement logiciel.
  • Expérience significative dans la conception et la livraison de solutions Web.
  • Expérience démontrée dans un environnement de livraison Agile.
  • Expérience en découverte des besoins utilisateurs, en rédaction de récits utilisateurs, de critères d'acceptation et de documentation fonctionnelle.
  • Expérience de collaboration avec des gestionnaires de produit, des designers UI/UX, des développeurs et des équipes d'assurance qualité.
  • Certification IIBA (CBAP, CCBA ou équivalent) constitue un atout.

Connaissances

  • Excellente capacité à transformer des besoins d'affaires en solutions fonctionnelles.
  • Solide compréhension des principes de conception de solutions Web modernes.
  • Bonne compréhension des architectures Web modernes, des API REST et des mécanismes d'intégration entre applications.
  • Expérience avec des outils de conception et de prototypage tels que Figma, Axure ou Balsamiq.
  • Expérience avec Jira et Confluence.
  • Bonne connaissance des outils d'IA générative (ChatGPT, Claude ou équivalent) et maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de rédaction de requêtes (« prompt engineering »).
  • Capacité à intégrer efficacement l'IA dans les activités d'analyse d'affaires, de prototypage, de conception fonctionnelle et de documentation.
  • Compréhension des possibilités, des limites et des considérations liées à l'utilisation responsable de l'intelligence artificielle.
  • Bonne connaissance des domaines de la gestion des ressources humaines, de la paie, de la gestion des talents ou des environnements syndiqués constitue un atout.
  • Capacité à identifier des opportunités d'intégration de l'intelligence artificielle dans les produits constitue un atout.
  • Connaissance des principes d'accessibilité Web (WCAG) constitue un atout.

Qualités personnelles

  • Leadership mobilisateur.
  • Esprit d'initiative et capacité à influencer positivement les équipes multidisciplinaires.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication, en facilitation et en animation d'ateliers collaboratifs.
  • Excellentes habiletés relationnelles et capacité à travailler en équipe.
  • Orientation client et approche centrée sur les utilisateurs.
  • Pensée systémique et résolution de problèmes complexes.
  • Esprit d'analyse et de synthèse.
  • Autonomie et sens des responsabilités.
  • Curiosité intellectuelle, apprentissage continu et capacité d'adaptation dans un environnement technologique en constante évolution.
  • Capacité à remettre en question les façons de faire afin d'améliorer continuellement les pratiques.
  • Esprit critique permettant de valider et de bonifier les résultats produits par les outils d'intelligence artificielle.
  • Capacité à exploiter les gains de productivité offerts par l'intelligence artificielle afin de concentrer son expertise sur les activités à forte valeur ajoutée.
  • Excellente gestion du temps, des priorités et des échéanciers.
  • Rigueur, souci du détail et orientation vers la qualité.
  • Excellente maîtrise du français, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit.

Pourquoi joindre LGI ?

  • Un environnement fondé sur la confiance, l'autonomie et la collaboration;
  • L’opportunité d’évoluer, de performer et de travailler avec des collègues curieux et talentueux;
  • Une culture d'apprentissage continu offrant du temps dédié à la formation, une plateforme reconnue de développement de vos compétences et l'accès à des outils de pointe;
  • Des projets stimulants qui contribuent à l'évolution des technologies de la santé et soutiennent le travail de plus de 320 000 professionnels, au bénéfice de plus de 6 millions de patients;
  • Un programme complet d'avantages sociaux incluant une assurance collective dès le premier jour, un REER collectif avec participation de l'employeur, la télémédecine 24/7, un programme d'aide aux employés et à leur famille, ainsi qu'un minimum de 3 semaines de vacances par année

Chez LGI Solutions Santé, nous valorisons la diversité, l’équité et l’inclusion. Nous croyons que la diversité des expériences, des perspectives et des parcours contribue à notre succès. Nous nous engageons à favoriser un environnement de travail inclusif, équitable et respectueux, où chaque personne peut s’épanouir et réaliser son plein potentiel. Nous encourageons toutes les personnes qualifiées à soumettre leur candidature.

Venez vous joindre à nous!

Depuis plus de 40 ans, LGI développe des solutions logicielles en santé. Aujourd'hui, l'IA est au cœur de notre façon de développer et s'intègre dans la prochaine génération de nos solutions — pas une finalité, mais le levier pour contribuer à la mission qui nous anime : améliorer la performance des établissements de soins de santé.

On cherche des talents exceptionnels — passionnés de technologie, curieux par nature, exigeants par conviction. Des gens pour qui explorer et innover est un réflexe, et qui veulent mettre leur énergie au service d'une mission qui va au-delà du développement du code et qui impacte des décisions, des processus, des humains.

Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) $115k - $135k/year

Position Requirement: Full-Time

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Superior, Colorado

Salary:

115K - 135K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Licensure, Education & Experience:                                    

Licensure in Colorado as a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner with experience working with persons who have various behavioral health issues such as, mood disorders, anxiety disorders, personality disorders, substance misuse, and other psychiatric impairments under the supervision of a consulting psychiatrist(s).  We welcome new graduates!

Preferred: Successful completion of PMHNP-BC exam(s).

This document represents the major duties, responsibilities, and authorities of this job, and is not intended to be a complete list of all tasks and functions. Other duties may be assigned as well. 

Salary: $115,000 – $135,000 / year

Location: Woburn, Massachusetts

Salary:

135K - 160K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LICSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.
